`/sc4sap:program-to-spec` Excel 출력 경로가 양식 보존 클론 방식으로 전환됨. 이제 sap-writer는 TR(translation) 맵만 만들고 `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`가 `asset/template_base.xlsx`를 byte-for-byte 클론 + sharedStrings.xml만 교체. workbook geometry는 100% reference와 동일.

template_base.xlsx에 기본 임베드된 두 PNG는 program-agnostic mockup이라 ≥95% 케이스 충분하지만, 프로그램별 실제 화면 mockup으로 교체하고 싶을 때 다음 절차:

**How to apply:** 사용자가 "이미지도 교체" / "프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드" / "PNG mockup 교체" 등 명시 요청 시에만 진행. 기본 program-to-spec 호출에서는 자동 실행 금지 (drift 재발 방지). 구현 시 template-clone.mjs와 같은 zero-dep 패턴 따르고 (`node:zlib` + `node:fs`만) `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`의 unzipEntries/zipFiles를 재사용하는 게 가장 깔끔. 새 헬퍼는 `scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs`로 만들고 CLI는 `node image-swap.mjs <target-xlsx> <new-image1-path> <new-image2-path>` 정도.

**관련 자산 위치 (2026-05-21 현재)**

**참조 메모리**: `feedback_xlsx_no_truncation.md`, `feedback_xlsx_style_v8.md`, `feedback_xlsx_processflow_v9.md`, `feedback_xlsx_multipane_alv_v10.md`는 옛 rich-xlsx-template 방식의 디테일 — **양식 보존 방식에서는 적용 안 됨** (geometry는 template_base가 결정). 그러나 향후 template_base.xlsx 자체를 업데이트할 일이 생기면 이 룰들은 reference workbook 디자인 가이드로 참고 가치 있음.

저번에 로컬 캐시에 저장해둔 작업사항 확인했어. 다음 작업으로 메모해둔 건 이거야:

## 프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드 (`/sc4sap:program-to-spec` 후속)

**배경 (2026-05-21 종료 시점)**
- Excel 출력 경로를 양식 보존 클론 방식으로 전환 완료 (`asset/template_base.xlsx` + `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`)
- 현재 sap-writer는 TR(translation) 맵만 만들고, template-clone이 byte-for-byte 클론 + sharedStrings.xml만 교체 → workbook geometry 100% reference와 동일
- template_base.xlsx에 임베드된 두 PNG는 program-agnostic mockup (≥95% 케이스 충분)

**다음 작업 = 프로그램별 실제 화면 mockup으로 PNG 교체할 수 있게 하는 헬퍼 구현**

구현 절차:
1. 새 PNG 두 개 렌더 — `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` 재사용 (헤드리스 브라우저 → SVG → PNG) 또는 사용자 공급 PNG
2. 클론된 출력 xlsx에서 `xl/media/image1.png` + `xl/media/image2.png` **교체** (template_base는 영구 reference로 유지, 절대 건드리지 않음)
3. `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` + `_rels/drawing3.xml.rels`는 **그대로 유지** — anchor 위치(image2=C4 ext 8572500×2667000, image1=C19 ext 9715500×1752600)와 rId1/rId2 매핑 동일하게 작동
4. xlsx 재압축

구현 가이드:
- 새 헬퍼: `scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs` (template-clone.mjs와 같은 zero-dep 패턴, `node:zlib` + `node:fs`만)

This turns opaque Z-references in the spec into named reusable assets.
19	  - **Missing** → Print one line: "No CBO inventory at `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/`. Run `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` first for richer spec annotations, or type `skip` to proceed."
20	- Persist the loaded entries to `.sc4sap/specs/<OBJECT>/cbo-context.md` so sap-analyst and sap-writer consume it in Step 3.
21	- Source:
22	  - Report/Program: `GetProgFullCode` + `GetIncludesList` → iterate `GetInclude`
23	  - Class: `ReadClass` (all sections) + `GetLocalDefinitions` / `GetLocalMacros` / `GetLocalTestClass` / `GetLocalTypes`

31

34	- Drives which spec template is applied in Step 3.

42	▶ phase=3.writer · agent=sap-writer · model=<Haiku 4.5 for L1/L2 | Sonnet 4.6 override for L3/L4>
43	▶ phase=3.critic (L4 only) · agent=sap-critic · model=Opus 4.7
44	```
45	
46	- **sap-analyst** (Opus 4.7, frontmatter) extracts: business purpose, inputs (selection screen / importing params), outputs (ALV cols / exporting params / OData entity), data sources (tables + CDS + BAPIs), main logic narrative, error cases, authorization checks (`AUTHORITY-CHECK` statements). When `cbo-context.md` exists, the analyst cross-references every Z-object mentioned against the inventory and replaces opaque "Z-table" / "Z-class" labels with the inventory's documented role + business purpose.
47	- **sap-writer** (Haiku 4.5 base; **`model: "sonnet"` override for L3/L4 depth** — longer narrative + deeper cross-reference + stronger consistency requirement) renders into the chosen format (MD or Excel) at the chosen depth + language.
48	- **sap-critic** (Opus 4.7, frontmatter) gate (only if L4): verifies every claim cross-references a line range.

51	
52	Excel output inherits the two reference mockup PNGs already embedded in `asset/template_base.xlsx` (Selection screen at C4, ALV grid at C19 on the `입력 및 화면` sheet) — drivers must NOT regenerate them. Custom per-program PNG replacement is a separate user-triggered task (see [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement).
53	
54	For **Markdown output only**, render every Selection-Screen and output Screen / ALV as an ASCII wireframe inside fenced code blocks (character widths are uniform there):
55	- Reconstruct Dynpros from `GetScreen` / `ReadScreen` (`HEADER` + `FLOW_LOGIC` + field positions `LINE` / `COLUMN` / `LENGTH` / `HEIGHT`).
56	- Reconstruct Selection-Screens from `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` / `SELECTION-SCREEN BLOCK` statements.
57	- Reconstruct ALV output from the field catalog (columns + widths + headings).
58	- Show label + input box + F4-help marker `[▼]` + mandatory `*`.
59	- Optional Mermaid `flowchart TD` for screen-to-screen navigation.
60	- For GUI Status: short FKEY → FCODE → text table plus an ASCII toolbar bar.
61	
62	For objects without UI (pure class, FM, CDS, RAP without screens), skip the wireframes — the Parameters table inside the Inputs section is enough.
63	
64	**Step 4 — Render**
65	- **Markdown**: single `.md` with H2 sections per spec dimension, tables for selection-screen / tables / methods / exits. See [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) for the section skeleton.
66	
67	- **Excel (MANDATORY workflow — 양식 보존 / format-preserving template clone)**:
68	
69	  > **Why clone, not build?** The previous "throwaway driver" workflow rebuilt the workbook geometry from JSON (SHEETS_DATA / SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC / ALV_IMAGE_SPEC / styles inline). It drifted from the agreed reference layout on every iteration — column widths, fonts, borders, image anchors all subtly off. To stop that drift, every Excel spec now CLONES `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and ONLY swaps `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. Styles, borders, fonts, column widths, row heights, drawings, embedded images stay identical to the reference. The sap-writer's only job is to produce a TR (translation) map; the helper writes the file.
70	
71	  Pipeline for each Excel-output spec:
72	
73	  1. **sap-writer produces the TR map** — a flat JSON object mapping every English source string in `asset/template_base.xlsx` to its target-language replacement for THIS program. Schema, slot semantics (5 parameter slots / 12 step slots / 10 output column slots / 5 auth rows / 3 exception rows), and the canonical key list are in [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md). Unused slots are filled with `— (해당 없음)` / `—` placeholders so the row count stays identical to the template. SAP standard identifiers (table names, field names, parameter names) that happen to match the source spec MUST be present in the TR map to remap them to the target program's identifiers; identifiers absent from TR remain unchanged.
74	  2. **Persist the TR map** to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed for review).
75	  3. **Run the template-clone helper**:
76	     ```bash
77	     node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json-path> <out-xlsx-path>
78	     ```
79	     The helper reads `asset/template_base.xlsx`, re-zips every entry byte-for-byte, replaces each `<t>…</t>` payload in `xl/sharedStrings.xml` using the TR map, and writes the output xlsx. Default output path is `.sc4sap/specs/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}-{lang}.xlsx`. Any English string lacking a TR entry is reported on stdout (`NO TRANSLATION:` lines) so the writer can patch the map and re-run.
80	  4. **Verify the artifact** — `ls` the output path (file size ≈ 90 KB), `unzip -l` lists `xl/sharedStrings.xml` plus the unchanged `xl/styles.xml`, `xl/worksheets/sheet1..7.xml`, `xl/drawings/drawing*.xml`, `xl/media/image1.png`, `xl/media/image2.png`. Open in Excel and scan every sheet — geometry MUST match `asset/template_base.xlsx` exactly.
81	  5. **Cleanup** — leave the TR JSON in place for traceability (it documents what was generated for this program). Remove only ephemeral files (HUD probes, smoke tests). Per-spec drivers do not exist anymore in this pipeline.
82	
83	  **Zero external npm dependencies** — `template-clone.mjs` uses only `node:zlib` + `node:fs` + `node:path` + `node:url`. Works fully offline after `git clone` on networks that block `registry.npmjs.org`.
84	
85	  **Sheet order is fixed by `asset/template_base.xlsx`** — clone never reorders. The template ships with:
86	  1. `프로그램 개요` / Program Overview — Field/Value metadata (17 rows)
87	  2. `데이터 모델` / Data Model — Table/Access/Key Fields/Join Type/Notes (4 table slots + trailer)
88	  3. `입력 및 화면` / Inputs & Screens — Parameters (5 slots) + 5 warning rows + 2 image anchors at C4 / C19
89	  4. `처리 로직` / Processing Logic — #/Event/Step (12 step slots) + Process Flow Chart heading
90	  5. `출력` / Output — Order/Field/Description/Length/Edit/Hidden (10 column slots)
91	  6. `권한` / Authorizations — Check/Object/Level/Implemented?/Notes (5 rows)
92	  7. `예외 처리` / Exceptions — Trigger/Mechanism/Message/Recovery (3 rows)
93	
94	  **Styles, borders, fonts, fills, column widths, row heights — all preserved** from `asset/template_base.xlsx`. Do NOT rebuild them in drivers; do NOT introduce parallel `rich-xlsx-template.mjs` style constants. The reference workbook is the single source of truth.
95	
96	  **Image anchors stay intact** — `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` anchors the two embedded images (Selection screen mockup at C4, ALV grid mockup at C19) on the `입력 및 화면` sheet. Swapping `sharedStrings.xml` does not touch drawings. To replace the embedded images for a specific program, see [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task, not part of the default clone path).
97	
98	**Step 5 — Review loop**
99	- Show a table of contents + first section inline.
100	- Ask: "OK to finalize, or trim/expand a section?"
101	- On confirm → write file → print absolute path.

- **sap-critic** (Opus 4.7, frontmatter) gate (only if L4): verifies every claim cross-references a line range.

**Step 3.5 — Draw screens (Markdown only)**

Excel output inherits the two reference mockup PNGs already embedded in `asset/template_base.xlsx` (Selection screen at C4, ALV grid at C19 on the `입력 및 화면` sheet) — drivers must NOT regenerate them. Custom per-program PNG replacement is a separate user-triggered task (see [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement).

For **Markdown output only**, render every Selection-Screen and output Screen / ALV as an ASCII wireframe inside fenced code blocks (character widths are uniform there):
- Reconstruct Dynpros from `GetScreen` / `ReadScreen` (`HEADER` + `FLOW_LOGIC` + field positions `LINE` / `COLUMN` / `LENGTH` / `HEIGHT`).
- Reconstruct Selection-Screens from `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` / `SELECTION-SCREEN BLOCK` statements.
- Reconstruct ALV output from the field catalog (columns + widths + headings).
- Show label + input box + F4-help marker `[▼]` + mandatory `*`.
- Optional Mermaid `flowchart TD` for screen-to-screen navigation.
- For GUI Status: short FKEY → FCODE → text table plus an ASCII toolbar bar.

For objects without UI (pure class, FM, CDS, RAP without screens), skip the wireframes — the Parameters table inside the Inputs section is enough.

**Step 4 — Render**
- **Markdown**: single `.md` with H2 sections per spec dimension, tables for selection-screen / tables / methods / exits. See [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) for the section skeleton.

- **Excel (MANDATORY workflow — 양식 보존 / format-preserving template clone)**:

  > **Why clone, not build?** The previous "throwaway driver" workflow rebuilt the workbook geometry from JSON (SHEETS_DATA / SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC / ALV_IMAGE_SPEC / styles inline). It drifted from the agreed reference layout on every iteration — column widths, fonts, borders, image anchors all subtly off. To stop that drift, every Excel spec now CLONES `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and ONLY swaps `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. Styles, borders, fonts, column widths, row heights, drawings, embedded images stay identical to the reference. The sap-writer's only job is to produce a TR (translation) map; the helper writes the file.

  Pipeline for each Excel-output spec:

  1. **sap-writer produces the TR map** — a flat JSON object mapping every English source string in `asset/template_base.xlsx` to its target-language replacement for THIS program. Schema, slot semantics (5 parameter slots / 12 step slots / 10 output column slots / 5 auth rows / 3 exception rows), and the canonical key list are in [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md). Unused slots are filled with `— (해당 없음)` / `—` placeholders so the row count stays identical to the template. SAP standard identifiers (table names, field names, parameter names) that happen to match the source spec MUST be present in the TR map to remap them to the target program's identifiers; identifiers absent from TR remain unchanged.
  2. **Persist the TR map** to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed for review).
  3. **Run the template-clone helper**:
     ```bash
     node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json-path> <out-xlsx-path>
     ```
     The helper reads `asset/template_base.xlsx`, re-zips every entry byte-for-byte, replaces each `<t>…</t>` payload in `xl/sharedStrings.xml` using the TR map, and writes the output xlsx. Default output path is `.sc4sap/specs/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}-{lang}.xlsx`. Any English string lacking a TR entry is reported on stdout (`NO TRANSLATION:` lines) so the writer can patch the map and re-run.
  4. **Verify the artifact** — `ls` the output path (file size ≈ 90 KB), `unzip -l` lists `xl/sharedStrings.xml` plus the unchanged `xl/styles.xml`, `xl/worksheets/sheet1..7.xml`, `xl/drawings/drawing*.xml`, `xl/media/image1.png`, `xl/media/image2.png`. Open in Excel and scan every sheet — geometry MUST match `asset/template_base.xlsx` exactly.
  5. **Cleanup** — leave the TR JSON in place for traceability (it documents what was generated for this program). Remove only ephemeral files (HUD probes, smoke tests). Per-spec drivers do not exist anymore in this pipeline.

  **Zero external npm dependencies** — `template-clone.mjs` uses only `node:zlib` + `node:fs` + `node:path` + `node:url`. Works fully offline after `git clone` on networks that block `registry.npmjs.org`.

  **Sheet order is fixed by `asset/template_base.xlsx`** — clone never reorders. The template ships with:
  1. `프로그램 개요` / Program Overview — Field/Value metadata (17 rows)
  2. `데이터 모델` / Data Model — Table/Access/Key Fields/Join Type/Notes (4 table slots + trailer)
  3. `입력 및 화면` / Inputs & Screens — Parameters (5 slots) + 5 warning rows + 2 image anchors at C4 / C19
  4. `처리 로직` / Processing Logic — #/Event/Step (12 step slots) + Process Flow Chart heading
  5. `출력` / Output — Order/Field/Description/Length/Edit/Hidden (10 column slots)
  6. `권한` / Authorizations — Check/Object/Level/Implemented?/Notes (5 rows)
  7. `예외 처리` / Exceptions — Trigger/Mechanism/Message/Recovery (3 rows)

  **Styles, borders, fonts, fills, column widths, row heights — all preserved** from `asset/template_base.xlsx`. Do NOT rebuild them in drivers; do NOT introduce parallel `rich-xlsx-template.mjs` style constants. The reference workbook is the single source of truth.

  **Image anchors stay intact** — `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` anchors the two embedded images (Selection screen mockup at C4, ALV grid mockup at C19) on the `입력 및 화면` sheet. Swapping `sharedStrings.xml` does not touch drawings. To replace the embedded images for a specific program, see [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task, not part of the default clone path).

**Step 5 — Review loop**
- Show a table of contents + first section inline.
- Ask: "OK to finalize, or trim/expand a section?"
- On confirm → write file → print absolute path.

# Program → Spec — Templates

Referenced by `SKILL.md`. Use these templates in Step 4 (Render).

## Markdown — L2 Standard Spec skeleton

```markdown
# Specification: {OBJECT_NAME}

- **Type**: {Report | Class | FM | CDS | RAP BO}
- **Package**: {PKG} · **Transport (original)**: {TR}
- **Author / Changed**: {user} / {date}
- **Archetype**: {ALV report | Batch | BDC | ...}
- **Purpose (1–2 sentences)**: ...

## 1. Business Context
## 2. Data Model
| Table / CDS | Access | Key Fields | Notes |
## 3. Inputs & Screens
## 4. Main Logic (step-by-step)
## 5. Outputs
## 6. Authorizations
## 7. Exceptions & Messages
## 8. Dependencies (BAPIs, RFCs, enhancements)

### 8.1 Parameters
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

(Report → `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` · FM/Class → `IMPORTING` · CDS → view params · RAP → action inputs.
 Always rendered, even when the object has no UI screens.)
### 8.2 Selection-Screen (only if screens exist) — ASCII wireframe in fenced block
### 8.3 Output — ALV / Dynpro 0100 (only if ALV/Dynpro output exists) — ASCII wireframe
### 8.4 Screen-flow (only if multi-screen) — Mermaid `flowchart LR`
## 9. Open Questions / Assumptions
```

## Excel — Template-clone (양식 보존) workflow

The Excel output is produced by cloning `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and swapping only `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. The clone helper is `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`. The sap-writer's deliverable is therefore a **TR (translation) map**, not a styled workbook.

### TR map schema

```jsonc
{
  "Program Overview (ZMMTEST003)": "프로그램 개요 (ZMMR1001)",
  "ZMMRTEST003":                   "ZMMR1001",
  "Object Type":                   "오브젝트 타입",
  "PROG/P (ABAP Report)":          "PROG/P (ABAP Report)",
  // … one entry per English source string in the template …
}
```

Flat object · key = English source string from `asset/template_base.xlsx` sharedStrings.xml · value = target-language replacement for THIS program. Persist to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed).

### Sheet layout (fixed by template_base — clone never reorders)

| # | Sheet (KO display) | Columns / rows in template |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 프로그램 개요 | Field / Value (17 metadata rows) |
| 2 | 데이터 모델 | Table / Access / Key Fields / Join Type / Notes — 4 table slots + CDS / BAPI / BAdI trailer rows |
| 3 | 입력 및 화면 | Parameters (5 slots) · 5 ⚠ warning rows · 2 image anchors (C4 = Selection mockup, C19 = ALV mockup) |
| 4 | 처리 로직 | # / Event / Step — 12 step slots + `Process Flow Chart` heading |
| 5 | 출력 | Order / Field / Field Description / Length / Edit / Hidden — 10 column slots |
| 6 | 권한 | Check / Auth Object / Level / Implemented? / Notes — 5 rows |
| 7 | 예외 처리 | Trigger / Mechanism / Message / Recovery — 3 rows |

### Slot semantics

When the target program has fewer items than the template's fixed slot count, **fill unused slots with placeholders** so row counts (and therefore borders, fills, styles) stay identical:

| Section | Template count | Placeholder convention |
|---|---|---|
| Sheet 3 Parameters | 5 (S_VKORG..S_VBELN) | `— (해당 없음)` for the field name, `—` for type/required/default, short note in the description |
| Sheet 3 Warnings | 5 ⚠ rows | Use real findings; if fewer than 5, repeat the most important caveat or summarise into 5 buckets |
| Sheet 4 Steps | 12 numbered rows | `— (해당 없음)` for the FORM name, brief explainer for the step text |
| Sheet 5 Output columns | 10 ALV column rows | `— (해당 없음)` for unused field, `—` for length |
| Sheet 6 Auth | 5 rows | Use real auth objects + GAP rows; rewire the 양식 row labels semantically when needed (e.g. `Sales Org row-level` → `플랜트 단위`) |
| Sheet 7 Exceptions | 3 rows | Combine if target has only 2; split if it has 4+ — keep the 3-row template count |

### SAP identifier remapping

Identifiers in the template (`ZMMRTEST003`, `VBAK`, `VBELN`, `S_VKORG`, etc.) MUST appear as TR keys mapping to the target program's identifiers when they differ (`ZMMR1001`, `MARA`, `MATNR`, `P_WERKS`). Identifiers absent from TR remain in the cloned file unchanged — that's the desired behaviour when the target shares the identifier with the template.

### Quality gates (before declaring done)

1. `node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json> <out-xlsx>` exits 0.
2. Stdout shows `NO TRANSLATION:` for ONLY the SAP standard identifiers the target program genuinely reuses (table names, field names common to both specs). Any prose / label / sheet-title / warning string missing from TR is a bug — patch and re-run.
3. `unzip -l <out-xlsx>` lists 32 entries identical to `asset/template_base.xlsx` (same names, similar sizes — only `xl/sharedStrings.xml` size differs).
4. Output file ≈ 90 KB.
5. Open in Excel — every sheet renders with identical geometry to `asset/template_base.xlsx`.

---
name: program-to-spec 이미지 임베드 후속 작업 (양식 보존 클론 방식 도입 후)
description: 2026-05-21에 양식 보존 클론 방식(asset/template_base.xlsx + scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs)으로 전환 완료. 다음 작업은 프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드 (사용자 명시 요청 시 진행).
type: project
originSessionId: 801b7a83-2db1-40db-b723-180c7b32ce5d
---
**현재 상태 (2026-05-21 종료 시점)**

`/sc4sap:program-to-spec` Excel 출력 경로가 양식 보존 클론 방식으로 전환됨. 이제 sap-writer는 TR(translation) 맵만 만들고 `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`가 `asset/template_base.xlsx`를 byte-for-byte 클론 + sharedStrings.xml만 교체. workbook geometry는 100% reference와 동일.

**Why:** 옛 throwaway driver 방식이 매 회 styles/borders/widths/anchors를 JSON에서 재구성해 drift 누적 → 사용자 명시 지적 ("양식예시 서식 그대로 지정한뒤에 내부 데이터만 바꾸면 되는데"). Notion 기록: https://www.notion.so/3660c55c555781dc8bdee5ee3bd1df1f

**다음 작업 (사용자 명시 요청 시): 프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드**

template_base.xlsx에 기본 임베드된 두 PNG는 program-agnostic mockup이라 ≥95% 케이스 충분하지만, 프로그램별 실제 화면 mockup으로 교체하고 싶을 때 다음 절차:

1. 새 PNG 두 개 렌더 (Selection screen / ALV grid 또는 Process Flow chart)
   - 기존 도구 재사용 가능: `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` (보존됨, 헤드리스 브라우저 → SVG → PNG)
   - 또는 사용자 공급 PNG
2. 클론된 출력 xlsx에서 **`xl/media/image1.png` + `xl/media/image2.png` 교체** (template_base는 건드리지 않음 — 영구 reference 유지)
3. `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` + `_rels/drawing3.xml.rels`는 **그대로 유지** — anchor 위치(image2=C4 ext 8572500×2667000, image1=C19 ext 9715500×1752600)와 rId1/rId2 매핑이 동일하게 작동
4. xlsx 재압축

**How to apply:** 사용자가 "이미지도 교체" / "프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드" / "PNG mockup 교체" 등 명시 요청 시에만 진행. 기본 program-to-spec 호출에서는 자동 실행 금지 (drift 재발 방지). 구현 시 template-clone.mjs와 같은 zero-dep 패턴 따르고 (`node:zlib` + `node:fs`만) `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`의 unzipEntries/zipFiles를 재사용하는 게 가장 깔끔. 새 헬퍼는 `scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs`로 만들고 CLI는 `node image-swap.mjs <target-xlsx> <new-image1-path> <new-image2-path>` 정도.

**관련 자산 위치 (2026-05-21 현재)**

- `asset/template_base.xlsx` (90 KB) — 영구 reference, 절대 수정 금지
- `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs` (208 lines) — 클론 헬퍼
- `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` (1064 lines) — 이미지 렌더러 (이미지 교체 task에서 재사용 예정)
- `skills/program-to-spec/SKILL.md` · `workflow-steps.md` · `spec-templates.md` — 워크플로우 문서 (모두 200-line cap 이내)
- 제거된 자산: `rich-xlsx-template.mjs`, `build-xlsx.mjs`, `CHANGE_ME.xlsx`

## Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task)

`asset/template_base.xlsx` ships two reference PNGs anchored on Sheet 3 (`입력 및 화면`):
- `xl/media/image2.png` (900×280) — Selection screen mockup, anchored at `<col>2</col><row>3</row>` (C4), ext `8572500 × 2667000` EMU.
- `xl/media/image1.png` (1020×184) — ALV grid mockup, anchored at `<col>2</col><row>18</row>` (C19), ext `9715500 × 1752600` EMU.

The default `program-to-spec` clone path leaves these images intact. The swap is **opt-in** — never run automatically. Trigger keywords: `이미지도 교체` · `프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드` · `PNG mockup 교체` · `regenerate the embedded images` · `swap embedded images`.

### CLI (zero-dep, after clone)

```bash
node scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs <out-xlsx> --selection <selection.png> --alv <alv.png>
```

- `--selection` → replaces `xl/media/image2.png` (top, C4 — Selection screen position)
- `--alv` → replaces `xl/media/image1.png` (bottom, C19 — ALV grid position)
- Either flag may be omitted; the omitted slot keeps the template image.
- Positional form (`<xlsx> <selection.png> <alv.png>`, use `-` to skip) also accepted.

PNG signature is verified before any write; non-PNG input is rejected without touching the xlsx. `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` and its `_rels/drawing3.xml.rels` are explicitly preserved byte-for-byte.

### Programmatic (in-memory, with screen-image-renderer)

```js
import { renderScreenImages } from './scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs';
import { swapImages } from './scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs';

const { selection, alv } = await renderScreenImages({
  selection: { fields: [/* PARAMETERS / SELECT-OPTIONS spec */] },
  alv:       { columns: [/* field catalog */], sampleRows: [/* ≤3 rows */] },
  lang: 'ko',
});
swapImages({
  xlsxPath: '.sc4sap/specs/ZMMR1001-20260524-ko.xlsx',
  selectionPng: selection?.pngBuffer,  // null when no headless browser → swap skipped
  alvPng:       alv?.pngBuffer,
});
```

`renderScreenImages` returns `null` per slot when no headless browser is available (Chrome / Edge / Chromium not on PATH); pass that `null` through and the template image is kept.

### Why opt-in only

Auto-replacement re-introduces the drift problem the clone workflow exists to prevent. The two template PNGs are program-agnostic mockups that work for ≥95% of specs. Replace them ONLY when the user explicitly asks for program-specific mockups — never silently from the default `program-to-spec` path.

## Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task)

`asset/template_base.xlsx` ships two reference PNGs on Sheet 3 (`입력 및 화면`) and reserves a blank container on Sheet 4 (`처리 로직`) for the per-program process flow:

| Slot | xlsx path | Sheet | Anchor | Ext (template default) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `selection`  | `xl/media/image2.png` | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C4  | 8572500 × 2667000 EMU | Reference mockup ships in template |
| `alv`        | `xl/media/image1.png` | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C19 | 9715500 × 1752600 EMU | Reference mockup ships in template |
| `processFlow`| `xl/media/image3.png` | 4 (처리 로직)    | B19 | computed from PNG IHDR (px × 9525) | Slot is created on demand — `drawing4.xml` is blank in the template because every program has its own flow chart |

The default `program-to-spec` clone path leaves the Sheet 3 images intact and leaves Sheet 4 without an image. The swap is **opt-in** — never run automatically. Trigger keywords: `이미지도 교체` · `프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드` · `PNG mockup 교체` · `regenerate the embedded images` · `swap embedded images`.

### CLI (zero-dep, after clone)

```bash
node scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs <out-xlsx> --selection <sel.png> --alv <alv.png> --process-flow <pf.png>
```

- `--selection`     → replaces `xl/media/image2.png` (Sheet 3, C4)
- `--alv`           → replaces `xl/media/image1.png` (Sheet 3, C19)
- `--process-flow`  → injects `xl/media/image3.png` + `drawing4.xml` oneCellAnchor + rels (Sheet 4, B19); ext = PNG width/height × 9525 EMU
- Any flag may be omitted; omitted slots keep their template state (image preserved for Sheet 3; Sheet 4 stays blank).
- Positional form (`<xlsx> <sel.png> <alv.png> <pf.png>`, use `-` to skip) also accepted.

PNG signature is verified before any write; non-PNG input is rejected without touching the xlsx. `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` and its rels are explicitly preserved byte-for-byte. `xl/drawings/drawing4.xml` is mutated **only** when `--process-flow` is supplied.

### Programmatic (in-memory, with screen-image-renderer)

```js
import { renderScreenImages } from './scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs';
import { swapImages } from './scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs';

const { selection, alv, processFlow } = await renderScreenImages({
  selection:   { fields: [/* PARAMETERS / SELECT-OPTIONS spec */] },
  alv:         { columns: [/* field catalog */], sampleRows: [/* ≤3 rows */] },
  processFlow: ['시작', '입력 검증', '? 자재 마스터 존재?', 'BAPI 호출', 'ALV 출력', '! 종료'],
  lang: 'ko',
});
swapImages({
  xlsxPath: '.sc4sap/specs/ZMMR1001-20260524-ko.xlsx',
  selectionPng:   selection?.pngBuffer,    // null when no headless browser → slot skipped
  alvPng:         alv?.pngBuffer,
  processFlowPng: processFlow?.pngBuffer,  // always rendered HORIZONTAL by renderScreenImages
});
```

Process Flow item prefixes: `?` = decision (diamond), `!` = terminal (pill), no prefix = process box. `renderScreenImages` forces **horizontal orientation** for the xlsx embed path so the entire flow fits one Excel viewport — Markdown callers that want a vertical chart should call `renderProcessFlowSVG()` directly with `orientation: 'vertical'` (the default).

`renderScreenImages` returns `null` per slot when no headless browser is available (Chrome / Edge / Chromium not on PATH); pass that `null` through and the slot stays in its template state.

### Why opt-in only

Auto-replacement re-introduces the drift problem the clone workflow exists to prevent. The two Sheet-3 template PNGs are program-agnostic mockups that work for ≥95% of specs. The Sheet-4 process flow is left blank by design (every program differs). Run the swap ONLY when the user explicitly asks for program-specific imagery — never silently from the default `program-to-spec` path.

# Program → Spec — Templates

Referenced by `SKILL.md`. Use these templates in Step 4 (Render).

## Markdown — L2 Standard Spec skeleton

```markdown
# Specification: {OBJECT_NAME}

- **Type**: {Report | Class | FM | CDS | RAP BO}
- **Package**: {PKG} · **Transport (original)**: {TR}
- **Author / Changed**: {user} / {date}
- **Archetype**: {ALV report | Batch | BDC | ...}
- **Purpose (1–2 sentences)**: ...

## 1. Business Context
## 2. Data Model
| Table / CDS | Access | Key Fields | Notes |
## 3. Inputs & Screens
## 4. Main Logic (step-by-step)
## 5. Outputs
## 6. Authorizations
## 7. Exceptions & Messages
## 8. Dependencies (BAPIs, RFCs, enhancements)

### 8.1 Parameters
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

(Report → `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` · FM/Class → `IMPORTING` · CDS → view params · RAP → action inputs.
 Always rendered, even when the object has no UI screens.)
### 8.2 Selection-Screen (only if screens exist) — ASCII wireframe in fenced block
### 8.3 Output — ALV / Dynpro 0100 (only if ALV/Dynpro output exists) — ASCII wireframe
### 8.4 Screen-flow (only if multi-screen) — Mermaid `flowchart LR`
## 9. Open Questions / Assumptions
```

## Excel — Template-clone (양식 보존) workflow

The Excel output is produced by cloning `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and swapping only `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. The clone helper is `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`. The sap-writer's deliverable is therefore a **TR (translation) map**, not a styled workbook.

### TR map schema

```jsonc
{
  "Program Overview (ZMMTEST003)": "프로그램 개요 (ZMMR1001)",
  "ZMMRTEST003":                   "ZMMR1001",
  "Object Type":                   "오브젝트 타입",
  "PROG/P (ABAP Report)":          "PROG/P (ABAP Report)",
  // … one entry per English source string in the template …
}
```

Flat object · key = English source string from `asset/template_base.xlsx` sharedStrings.xml · value = target-language replacement for THIS program. Persist to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed).

### Sheet layout (fixed by template_base — clone never reorders)

| # | Sheet (KO display) | Columns / rows in template |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 프로그램 개요 | Field / Value (17 metadata rows) |
| 2 | 데이터 모델 | Table / Access / Key Fields / Join Type / Notes — 4 table slots + CDS / BAPI / BAdI trailer rows |
| 3 | 입력 및 화면 | Parameters (5 slots) · 5 ⚠ warning rows · 2 image anchors (C4 = Selection mockup, C19 = ALV mockup) |
| 4 | 처리 로직 | # / Event / Step — 12 step slots + `Process Flow Chart` heading |
| 5 | 출력 | Order / Field / Field Description / Length / Edit / Hidden — 10 column slots |
| 6 | 권한 | Check / Auth Object / Level / Implemented? / Notes — 5 rows |
| 7 | 예외 처리 | Trigger / Mechanism / Message / Recovery — 3 rows |

### Slot semantics

When the target program has fewer items than the template's fixed slot count, **fill unused slots with placeholders** so row counts (and therefore borders, fills, styles) stay identical:

| Section | Template count | Placeholder convention |
|---|---|---|
| Sheet 3 Parameters | 5 (S_VKORG..S_VBELN) | `— (해당 없음)` for the field name, `—` for type/required/default, short note in the description |
| Sheet 3 Warnings | 5 ⚠ rows | Use real findings; if fewer than 5, repeat the most important caveat or summarise into 5 buckets |
| Sheet 4 Steps | 12 numbered rows | `— (해당 없음)` for the FORM name, brief explainer for the step text |
| Sheet 5 Output columns | 10 ALV column rows | `— (해당 없음)` for unused field, `—` for length |
| Sheet 6 Auth | 5 rows | Use real auth objects + GAP rows; rewire the 양식 row labels semantically when needed (e.g. `Sales Org row-level` → `플랜트 단위`) |
| Sheet 7 Exceptions | 3 rows | Combine if target has only 2; split if it has 4+ — keep the 3-row template count |

### SAP identifier remapping

Identifiers in the template (`ZMMRTEST003`, `VBAK`, `VBELN`, `S_VKORG`, etc.) MUST appear as TR keys mapping to the target program's identifiers when they differ (`ZMMR1001`, `MARA`, `MATNR`, `P_WERKS`). Identifiers absent from TR remain in the cloned file unchanged — that's the desired behaviour when the target shares the identifier with the template.

### Quality gates (before declaring done)

1. `node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json> <out-xlsx>` exits 0.
2. Stdout shows `NO TRANSLATION:` for ONLY the SAP standard identifiers the target program genuinely reuses (table names, field names common to both specs). Any prose / label / sheet-title / warning string missing from TR is a bug — patch and re-run.
3. `unzip -l <out-xlsx>` lists 32 entries identical to `asset/template_base.xlsx` (same names, similar sizes — only `xl/sharedStrings.xml` size differs).
4. Output file ≈ 90 KB.
5. Open in Excel — every sheet renders with identical geometry to `asset/template_base.xlsx`.

---
name: program-to-spec 이미지 임베드 (3-slot — selection / alv / processFlow horizontal)
description: 2026-05-24 image-swap 완성 후 processFlow horizontal 슬롯 확장. Sheet 4 drawing4.xml 동적 anchor 주입 (블랭크 → oneCellAnchor + rels + image3.png).
type: project
originSessionId: 801b7a83-2db1-40db-b723-180c7b32ce5d
---
**현재 상태 (2026-05-24 종료 시점 — 2차 작업)**

이미지 swap 파이프라인이 **3-slot으로 확장됨**. Sheet 3 (selection/alv) + Sheet 4 (processFlow horizontal). 사용자 명시: "프로그램마다 처리 흐름도가 다르니까 빈 셀로 놔둔거야 ... 가로로 그려서 이미지 임베드" — 따라서 drawing4.xml은 template_base에 블랭크로 유지하고 image-swap이 런타임에 anchor + rels + media 주입.

**전체 파이프라인**

```
clone (template-clone.mjs) → tmp.xlsx (Sheet 4 drawing은 블랭크 컨테이너)
                          ↓ (사용자 명시 트리거 시)
                          screen-image-renderer.mjs
                            ├ selection → SVG → PNG
                            ├ alv       → SVG → PNG
                            └ processFlow → HORIZONTAL SVG → PNG  ★ xlsx 경로는 항상 가로
                          ↓
                          image-swap.mjs
                            ├ image2.png replace (Sheet 3 selection)
                            ├ image1.png replace (Sheet 3 alv)
                            └ image3.png + drawing4.xml + rels INJECT (Sheet 4)
```

**슬롯 매핑 (혼동 주의)**
| Slot | xlsx path | Sheet | Anchor | 비고 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| selection   | xl/media/image2.png | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C4  (col=2, row=3 0-idx)  | 템플릿에 기본 mockup |
| alv         | xl/media/image1.png | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C19 (col=2, row=18 0-idx) | 템플릿에 기본 mockup |
| processFlow | xl/media/image3.png | 4 (처리 로직)    | B19 (col=1, row=18 0-idx) | 템플릿 블랭크, swap이 동적 생성 |

processFlow `ext` = PNG width/height × 9525 EMU (96 dpi). PNG IHDR(byte 16~23)에서 동적으로 읽음.

**구현/수정 파일 (2026-05-24 종료 기준)**
- `scripts/spec/xlsx-zip.mjs` (93L) — 공유 ZIP read/write
- `scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs` (169L) — 3-slot swap + drawing4.xml 동적 주입 + CLI (`--selection`/`--alv`/`--process-flow`)
- `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs` (124L) — xlsx-zip import (기존 API 무변경)
- `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` (1180L) — `renderProcessFlowHorizontalSVG` + `processFlowHorizontalMetrics` 신규, `renderProcessFlowSVG`에 `orientation` 옵션 추가, `renderScreenImages`는 processFlow를 항상 horizontal로 호출
- `skills/program-to-spec/workflow-steps.md` (112L) — Step 4.5 processFlow 슬롯 추가
- `skills/program-to-spec/spec-templates.md` (144L) — § Image Replacement 3-slot 표 + horizontal 강제 명시

모두 200L cap 준수 (screen-image-renderer는 scripts/spec 하위라 cap 적용 대상 아님).

**트리거 키워드**
`이미지도 교체` · `프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드` · `PNG mockup 교체` · `regenerate the embedded images` · `swap embedded images` 중 하나 감지 시에만 실행.

**검증 완료**
1. 가로 SVG 1275×175 px 렌더 (세로 874×547 대비 가시성 우수)
2. drawing4.xml에 `<xdr:oneCellAnchor>` 정확히 주입 (col=1 row=18 ext=12144375×1666875 = 1275×175 × 9525)
3. drawing4.xml.rels 신규 생성 (rId1 → image3.png)
4. drawing3.xml + image1.png + image2.png 완벽 보존 (Sheet 3 영향 0)
5. 3-slot 합본 swap 후 tmp_e2e_full.xlsx 94977 B 생성 (Excel 열기 가능)
6. `[Content_Types].xml` 무수정 (이미 PNG Default + drawing4 Override 있음 — 검증됨)

**Process Flow 아이템 prefix 컨벤션** (renderer가 인식)
- `?` 접두 → decision (다이아몬드, 노란색 fill)
- `!` 접두 → terminal (pill, 회색 fill)
- 접두 없음 → process (직사각형, 흰색 fill)
- 박스 간 자동 → 화살표 (가로 layout) / ↓ 화살표 (세로 layout)

**Vertical vs Horizontal 분리 원칙**
- `renderProcessFlowSVG()` 직접 호출 → default `orientation='vertical'` (Markdown ASCII 스펙용)
- `renderScreenImages()` → processFlow는 항상 `orientation='horizontal'` 강제 (xlsx embed 경로)
- 사용자 명시 (2026-05-24): "꼭 세로 레이아웃이 아닌 가로로" → xlsx 경로 가로 고정

**Fallback 정책**
헤드리스 브라우저(Chrome/Edge/Chromium) 없을 때 `renderScreenImages`가 slot당 `null` 반환 → `swapImages`에 그대로 전달하면 그 slot은 템플릿 상태 유지 (Sheet 3 = 기본 이미지, Sheet 4 = 블랭크). 크래시 안 함.

**How to apply (다음 세션 / 사용자 명시 트리거 시)**
1. `cloneTemplate({ outPath, tr })` → out.xlsx (Sheet 4 블랭크)
2. `await renderScreenImages({ selection, alv, processFlow, lang })` → 3개 pngBuffer
3. `swapImages({ xlsxPath: out.xlsx, selectionPng, alvPng, processFlowPng })`
4. 결과 xlsx Excel에서 열어 Sheet 3 (입력 및 화면) 새 mockup + Sheet 4 (처리 로직) 가로 process flow 확인

**검증 산출물**
- `tmp_e2e_full.xlsx` (94977 B, 작업 디렉토리에 남음) — 사용자 시각 확인용. selection 1035×267 + alv 1035×154 + processFlow 1275×175 horizontal 모두 embed.

**참조 메모리**: `feedback_xlsx_*` v4~v10은 옛 rich-xlsx-template 디테일 — 양식 보존 클론에선 비활성. image-swap도 geometry 무관(template_base가 결정).

**현재 상태 (2026-05-24 종료 시점 — 2차 작업)**

이미지 swap 파이프라인이 **3-slot으로 확장됨**. Sheet 3 (selection/alv) + Sheet 4 (processFlow horizontal). 사용자 명시: "프로그램마다 처리 흐름도가 다르니까 빈 셀로 놔둔거야 ... 가로로 그려서 이미지 임베드" — 따라서 drawing4.xml은 template_base에 블랭크로 유지하고 image-swap이 런타임에 anchor + rels + media 주입.

**전체 파이프라인**

```
clone (template-clone.mjs) → tmp.xlsx (Sheet 4 drawing은 블랭크 컨테이너)
                          ↓ (사용자 명시 트리거 시)
                          screen-image-renderer.mjs
                            ├ selection → SVG → PNG
                            ├ alv       → SVG → PNG
                            └ processFlow → HORIZONTAL SVG → PNG  ★ xlsx 경로는 항상 가로
                          ↓
                          image-swap.mjs
                            ├ image2.png replace (Sheet 3 selection)
                            ├ image1.png replace (Sheet 3 alv)
                            └ image3.png + drawing4.xml + rels INJECT (Sheet 4)
```

`이미지도 교체` · `프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드` · `PNG mockup 교체` · `regenerate the embedded images` · `swap embedded images` 중 하나 감지 시에만 실행.

1. 가로 SVG 1275×175 px 렌더 (세로 874×547 대비 가시성 우수)
2. drawing4.xml에 `<xdr:oneCellAnchor>` 정확히 주입 (col=1 row=18 ext=12144375×1666875 = 1275×175 × 9525)

5. 3-slot 합본 swap 후 tmp_e2e_full.xlsx 94977 B 생성 (Excel 열기 가능)
6. `[Content_Types].xml` 무수정 (이미 PNG Default + drawing4 Override 있음 — 검증됨)

**Process Flow 아이템 prefix 컨벤션** (renderer가 인식)
- `?` 접두 → decision (다이아몬드, 노란색 fill)
- `!` 접두 → terminal (pill, 회색 fill)
- 접두 없음 → process (직사각형, 흰색 fill)
- 박스 간 자동 → 화살표 (가로 layout) / ↓ 화살표 (세로 layout)

**Vertical vs Horizontal 분리 원칙**
- `renderProcessFlowSVG()` 직접 호출 → default `orientation='vertical'` (Markdown ASCII 스펙용)
- `renderScreenImages()` → processFlow는 항상 `orientation='horizontal'` 강제 (xlsx embed 경로)
- 사용자 명시 (2026-05-24): "꼭 세로 레이아웃이 아닌 가로로" → xlsx 경로 가로 고정

**Fallback 정책**
헤드리스 브라우저(Chrome/Edge/Chromium) 없을 때 `renderScreenImages`가 slot당 `null` 반환 → `swapImages`에 그대로 전달하면 그 slot은 템플릿 상태 유지 (Sheet 3 = 기본 이미지, Sheet 4 = 블랭크). 크래시 안 함.

**How to apply (다음 세션 / 사용자 명시 트리거 시)**
1. `cloneTemplate({ outPath, tr })` → out.xlsx (Sheet 4 블랭크)
2. `await renderScreenImages({ selection, alv, processFlow, lang })` → 3개 pngBuffer
3. `swapImages({ xlsxPath: out.xlsx, selectionPng, alvPng, processFlowPng })`
4. 결과 xlsx Excel에서 열어 Sheet 3 (입력 및 화면) 새 mockup + Sheet 4 (처리 로직) 가로 process flow 확인

**검증 산출물**
- `tmp_e2e_full.xlsx` (94977 B, 작업 디렉토리에 남음) — 사용자 시각 확인용. selection 1035×267 + alv 1035×154 + processFlow 1275×175 horizontal 모두 embed.

## 원인
**drawing3.xml의 `<xdr:ext>`가 템플릿 PNG 크기(900×280, 1020×184)에 고정**돼 있어서, 새로 렌더한 PNG(1035×267, 1035×154)가 **고정된 슬롯 안에 강제로 늘어남**:

image-swap이 selection/alv swap 시 **drawing3.xml의 해당 oneCellAnchor 블록의 cx/cy를 새 PNG IHDR 크기(px × 9525 EMU)로 surgical 갱신**. 블록 식별은 `name="image1.png"` / `name="image2.png"`로 — 순서 의존 X, robust. anchor 위치(from col/row)는 무수정.

| selection (image2) | 1035×267 | **1035×267** ✓ |
| alv (image1) | 1035×154 | **1035×154** ✓ |

# Program → Spec — Templates

Referenced by `SKILL.md`. Use these templates in Step 4 (Render).

## Markdown — L2 Standard Spec skeleton

```markdown
# Specification: {OBJECT_NAME}

- **Type**: {Report | Class | FM | CDS | RAP BO}
- **Package**: {PKG} · **Transport (original)**: {TR}
- **Author / Changed**: {user} / {date}
- **Archetype**: {ALV report | Batch | BDC | ...}
- **Purpose (1–2 sentences)**: ...

## 1. Business Context
## 2. Data Model
| Table / CDS | Access | Key Fields | Notes |
## 3. Inputs & Screens
## 4. Main Logic (step-by-step)
## 5. Outputs
## 6. Authorizations
## 7. Exceptions & Messages
## 8. Dependencies (BAPIs, RFCs, enhancements)

### 8.1 Parameters
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

(Report → `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` · FM/Class → `IMPORTING` · CDS → view params · RAP → action inputs.
 Always rendered, even when the object has no UI screens.)
### 8.2 Selection-Screen (only if screens exist) — ASCII wireframe in fenced block
### 8.3 Output — ALV / Dynpro 0100 (only if ALV/Dynpro output exists) — ASCII wireframe
### 8.4 Screen-flow (only if multi-screen) — Mermaid `flowchart LR`
## 9. Open Questions / Assumptions
```

## Excel — Template-clone (양식 보존) workflow

The Excel output is produced by cloning `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and swapping only `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. The clone helper is `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`. The sap-writer's deliverable is therefore a **TR (translation) map**, not a styled workbook.

### TR map schema

```jsonc
{
  "Program Overview (ZMMTEST003)": "프로그램 개요 (ZMMR1001)",
  "ZMMRTEST003":                   "ZMMR1001",
  "Object Type":                   "오브젝트 타입",
  "PROG/P (ABAP Report)":          "PROG/P (ABAP Report)",
  // … one entry per English source string in the template …
}
```

Flat object · key = English source string from `asset/template_base.xlsx` sharedStrings.xml · value = target-language replacement for THIS program. Persist to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed).

### Sheet layout (fixed by template_base — clone never reorders)

| # | Sheet (KO display) | Columns / rows in template |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 프로그램 개요 | Field / Value (17 metadata rows) |
| 2 | 데이터 모델 | Table / Access / Key Fields / Join Type / Notes — 4 table slots + CDS / BAPI / BAdI trailer rows |
| 3 | 입력 및 화면 | Parameters (5 slots) · 5 ⚠ warning rows · 2 image anchors (C4 = Selection mockup, C19 = ALV mockup) |
| 4 | 처리 로직 | # / Event / Step — 12 step slots + `Process Flow Chart` heading |
| 5 | 출력 | Order / Field / Field Description / Length / Edit / Hidden — 10 column slots |
| 6 | 권한 | Check / Auth Object / Level / Implemented? / Notes — 5 rows |
| 7 | 예외 처리 | Trigger / Mechanism / Message / Recovery — 3 rows |

### Slot semantics

When the target program has fewer items than the template's fixed slot count, **fill unused slots with placeholders** so row counts (and therefore borders, fills, styles) stay identical:

| Section | Template count | Placeholder convention |
|---|---|---|
| Sheet 3 Parameters | 5 (S_VKORG..S_VBELN) | `— (해당 없음)` for the field name, `—` for type/required/default, short note in the description |
| Sheet 3 Warnings | 5 ⚠ rows | Use real findings; if fewer than 5, repeat the most important caveat or summarise into 5 buckets |
| Sheet 4 Steps | 12 numbered rows | `— (해당 없음)` for the FORM name, brief explainer for the step text |
| Sheet 5 Output columns | 10 ALV column rows | `— (해당 없음)` for unused field, `—` for length |
| Sheet 6 Auth | 5 rows | Use real auth objects + GAP rows; rewire the 양식 row labels semantically when needed (e.g. `Sales Org row-level` → `플랜트 단위`) |
| Sheet 7 Exceptions | 3 rows | Combine if target has only 2; split if it has 4+ — keep the 3-row template count |

### SAP identifier remapping

Identifiers in the template (`ZMMRTEST003`, `VBAK`, `VBELN`, `S_VKORG`, etc.) MUST appear as TR keys mapping to the target program's identifiers when they differ (`ZMMR1001`, `MARA`, `MATNR`, `P_WERKS`). Identifiers absent from TR remain in the cloned file unchanged — that's the desired behaviour when the target shares the identifier with the template.

### Quality gates (before declaring done)

1. `node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json> <out-xlsx>` exits 0.
2. Stdout shows `NO TRANSLATION:` for ONLY the SAP standard identifiers the target program genuinely reuses (table names, field names common to both specs). Any prose / label / sheet-title / warning string missing from TR is a bug — patch and re-run.
3. `unzip -l <out-xlsx>` lists 32 entries identical to `asset/template_base.xlsx` (same names, similar sizes — only `xl/sharedStrings.xml` size differs).
4. Output file ≈ 90 KB.
5. Open in Excel — every sheet renders with identical geometry to `asset/template_base.xlsx`.

## Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task)

`asset/template_base.xlsx` ships two reference PNGs on Sheet 3 (`입력 및 화면`) and reserves a blank container on Sheet 4 (`처리 로직`) for the per-program process flow:

| Slot | xlsx path | Sheet | Anchor | Ext (template default) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `selection`  | `xl/media/image2.png` | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C4  | 8572500 × 2667000 EMU | Reference mockup ships in template |
| `alv`        | `xl/media/image1.png` | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C19 | 9715500 × 1752600 EMU | Reference mockup ships in template |
| `processFlow`| `xl/media/image3.png` | 4 (처리 로직)    | B19 | computed from PNG IHDR (px × 9525) | Slot is created on demand — `drawing4.xml` is blank in the template because every program has its own flow chart |

The default `program-to-spec` clone path leaves the Sheet 3 images intact and leaves Sheet 4 without an image. The swap is **opt-in** — never run automatically. Trigger keywords: `이미지도 교체` · `프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드` · `PNG mockup 교체` · `regenerate the embedded images` · `swap embedded images`.

### CLI (zero-dep, after clone)

```bash
node scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs <out-xlsx> --selection <sel.png> --alv <alv.png> --process-flow <pf.png>
```

- `--selection`     → replaces `xl/media/image2.png` (Sheet 3, C4)
- `--alv`           → replaces `xl/media/image1.png` (Sheet 3, C19)
- `--process-flow`  → injects `xl/media/image3.png` + `drawing4.xml` oneCellAnchor + rels (Sheet 4, B19); ext = PNG width/height × 9525 EMU
- Any flag may be omitted; omitted slots keep their template state (image preserved for Sheet 3; Sheet 4 stays blank).
- Positional form (`<xlsx> <sel.png> <alv.png> <pf.png>`, use `-` to skip) also accepted.

PNG signature is verified before any write; non-PNG input is rejected without touching the xlsx. `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` and its rels are explicitly preserved byte-for-byte. `xl/drawings/drawing4.xml` is mutated **only** when `--process-flow` is supplied.

### Programmatic (in-memory, with screen-image-renderer)

```js
import { renderScreenImages } from './scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs';
import { swapImages } from './scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs';

const { selection, alv, processFlow } = await renderScreenImages({
  selection:   { fields: [/* PARAMETERS / SELECT-OPTIONS spec */] },
  alv:         { columns: [/* field catalog */], sampleRows: [/* ≤3 rows */] },
  processFlow: ['시작', '입력 검증', '? 자재 마스터 존재?', 'BAPI 호출', 'ALV 출력', '! 종료'],
  lang: 'ko',
});
swapImages({
  xlsxPath: '.sc4sap/specs/ZMMR1001-20260524-ko.xlsx',
  selectionPng:   selection?.pngBuffer,    // null when no headless browser → slot skipped
  alvPng:         alv?.pngBuffer,
  processFlowPng: processFlow?.pngBuffer,  // always rendered HORIZONTAL by renderScreenImages
});
```

Process Flow item prefixes: `?` = decision (diamond), `!` = terminal (pill), no prefix = process box. `renderScreenImages` forces **horizontal orientation** for the xlsx embed path so the entire flow fits one Excel viewport — Markdown callers that want a vertical chart should call `renderProcessFlowSVG()` directly with `orientation: 'vertical'` (the default).

`renderScreenImages` returns `null` per slot when no headless browser is available (Chrome / Edge / Chromium not on PATH); pass that `null` through and the slot stays in its template state.

### Why opt-in only

Auto-replacement re-introduces the drift problem the clone workflow exists to prevent. The two Sheet-3 template PNGs are program-agnostic mockups that work for ≥95% of specs. The Sheet-4 process flow is left blank by design (every program differs). Run the swap ONLY when the user explicitly asks for program-specific imagery — never silently from the default `program-to-spec` path.

**현재 상태 (2026-05-24 종료 시점 — 2차 작업)**

이미지 swap 파이프라인이 **3-slot으로 확장됨**. Sheet 3 (selection/alv) + Sheet 4 (processFlow horizontal). 사용자 명시: "프로그램마다 처리 흐름도가 다르니까 빈 셀로 놔둔거야 ... 가로로 그려서 이미지 임베드" — 따라서 drawing4.xml은 template_base에 블랭크로 유지하고 image-swap이 런타임에 anchor + rels + media 주입.

**전체 파이프라인**

```
clone (template-clone.mjs) → tmp.xlsx (Sheet 4 drawing은 블랭크 컨테이너)
                          ↓ (사용자 명시 트리거 시)
                          screen-image-renderer.mjs
                            ├ selection → SVG → PNG
                            ├ alv       → SVG → PNG
                            └ processFlow → HORIZONTAL SVG → PNG  ★ xlsx 경로는 항상 가로
                          ↓
                          image-swap.mjs
                            ├ image2.png replace (Sheet 3 selection)
                            ├ image1.png replace (Sheet 3 alv)
                            └ image3.png + drawing4.xml + rels INJECT (Sheet 4)
```

**슬롯 매핑 (혼동 주의)**
| Slot | xlsx path | Sheet | Anchor | ext 계산 | 비고 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| selection   | xl/media/image2.png | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C4  (col=2, row=3 0-idx)  | PNG IHDR × 9525 (동적) | 템플릿에 기본 mockup |
| alv         | xl/media/image1.png | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C19 (col=2, row=18 0-idx) | PNG IHDR × 9525 (동적) | 템플릿에 기본 mockup |
| processFlow | xl/media/image3.png | 4 (처리 로직)    | B19 (col=1, row=18 0-idx) | PNG IHDR × 9525 (동적) | 템플릿 블랭크, swap이 동적 생성 |

**모든 슬롯 ext는 새 PNG IHDR에서 동적 계산** (98 dpi 기준 1 px = 9525 EMU). 템플릿 default ext 재사용 금지 — aspect 다른 PNG가 stretch되어 텍스트가 짜부라짐 (2026-05-24 1차 작업에서 fix):
- 3.21:1 selection 슬롯에 3.88:1 PNG → 가로 짜부라짐
- 5.54:1 alv 슬롯에 6.72:1 PNG → 가로 짜부라짐
drawing3.xml은 oneCellAnchor 블록을 image name(image1.png/image2.png)으로 식별해 `<xdr:ext cx="..." cy="..."/>`만 surgical 갱신. from col/row 위치는 무수정.

content.text:
수정 완료.

## 진짜 원인
**함수 버그 아니라 내가 호출 schema를 잘못 줬어** — `renderAlvLayoutSVG`는:
- `columns[i].name`을 key로, `columns[i].header`를 헤더 텍스트로 사용
- `sampleRows[i]`는 **객체** (값은 `r[c.name]`로 조회)

근데 내가 보낸 건:
- ❌ `field`/`text` 키 → 헤더 undefined
- ❌ `sampleRows` 배열 형식 → 모든 셀 `undefined` → 빈 칸
- ❌ `width: 14` (너무 작음)
- 결과: 거의 빈 PNG → **1311 B**

올바른 schema로 재호출:
- ✅ `{ name, header, width, align }` columns
- ✅ `{ MATNR: '...', MAKTX: '...', ... }` 객체 sampleRows
- 결과: 데이터 들어간 PNG → **12601 B** (약 10배)

## 결과
`tmp_e2e_v2.xlsx` (106282 B) 새로 생성 — 옛 `tmp_e2e_full.xlsx`는 Excel에서 열어두고 있어서 잠겨있었음 (그건 닫아도 돼). 새 파일 Sheet 3 (입력 및 화면):
- Selection: 4개 필드 (회사코드 *, 플랜트 *, 자재번호 범위 LOW~HIGH)
- **ALV: 4컬럼 + 3 데이터 행 (HALB-001234 반제품 A 120.00 EA …)** ← 이번엔 표시될 거야

## 재발 방지
`spec-templates.md` § Image Replacement § Programmatic에 **정확한 schema 박아둠** — column key (`name`/`header`/`width`/`align`/`hotspot`/`editable`), sampleRows가 객체 형식인 점, 특수 key (`_status`/`_locked`), `range` (not `isRange`) 등을 실제 예시값과 함께 명시. sap-writer가 향후 호출할 때 이 예시 그대로 따르면 같은 함정 안 빠짐.

또한 메모에 **PNG 사이즈로 1차 검증**하는 휴리스틱 추가 (정상 ALV ~12KB vs 빈 그리드 ~1KB) — 다음 세션에서 swap 결과 의심스러우면 사이즈 먼저 보면 됨.

64	**Step 4 — Render**
65	- **Markdown**: single `.md` with H2 sections per spec dimension, tables for selection-screen / tables / methods / exits. See [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) for the section skeleton.
66	
67	- **Excel (MANDATORY workflow — 양식 보존 / format-preserving template clone)**:
68	
69	  > **Why clone, not build?** The previous "throwaway driver" workflow rebuilt the workbook geometry from JSON (SHEETS_DATA / SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC / ALV_IMAGE_SPEC / styles inline). It drifted from the agreed reference layout on every iteration — column widths, fonts, borders, image anchors all subtly off. To stop that drift, every Excel spec now CLONES `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and ONLY swaps `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. Styles, borders, fonts, column widths, row heights, drawings, embedded images stay identical to the reference. The sap-writer's only job is to produce a TR (translation) map; the helper writes the file.
70	
71	  Pipeline for each Excel-output spec:
72	
73	  1. **sap-writer produces the TR map** — a flat JSON object mapping every English source string in `asset/template_base.xlsx` to its target-language replacement for THIS program. Schema, slot semantics (5 parameter slots / 12 step slots / 10 output column slots / 5 auth rows / 3 exception rows), and the canonical key list are in [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md). Unused slots are filled with `— (해당 없음)` / `—` placeholders so the row count stays identical to the template. SAP standard identifiers (table names, field names, parameter names) that happen to match the source spec MUST be present in the TR map to remap them to the target program's identifiers; identifiers absent from TR remain unchanged.
74	  2. **Persist the TR map** to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed for review).
75	  3. **Run the template-clone helper**:
76	     ```bash
77	     node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json-path> <out-xlsx-path>
78	     ```
79	     The helper reads `asset/template_base.xlsx`, re-zips every entry byte-for-byte, replaces each `<t>…</t>` payload in `xl/sharedStrings.xml` using the TR map, and writes the output xlsx. Default output path is `.sc4sap/specs/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}-{lang}.xlsx`. Any English string lacking a TR entry is reported on stdout (`NO TRANSLATION:` lines) so the writer can patch the map and re-run.
80	  4. **Verify the artifact** — `ls` the output path (file size ≈ 90 KB), `unzip -l` lists `xl/sharedStrings.xml` plus the unchanged `xl/styles.xml`, `xl/worksheets/sheet1..7.xml`, `xl/drawings/drawing*.xml`, `xl/media/image1.png`, `xl/media/image2.png`. Open in Excel and scan every sheet — geometry MUST match `asset/template_base.xlsx` exactly.
81	  5. **Cleanup** — leave the TR JSON in place for traceability (it documents what was generated for this program). Remove only ephemeral files (HUD probes, smoke tests). Per-spec drivers do not exist anymore in this pipeline.
82	
83	  **Zero external npm dependencies** — `template-clone.mjs` uses only `node:zlib` + `node:fs` + `node:path` + `node:url`. Works fully offline after `git clone` on networks that block `registry.npmjs.org`.
84	
85	  **Sheet order is fixed by `asset/template_base.xlsx`** — clone never reorders. The template ships with:
86	  1. `프로그램 개요` / Program Overview — Field/Value metadata (17 rows)
87	  2. `데이터 모델` / Data Model — Table/Access/Key Fields/Join Type/Notes (4 table slots + trailer)
88	  3. `입력 및 화면` / Inputs & Screens — Parameters (5 slots) + 5 warning rows + 2 image anchors at C4 / C19
89	  4. `처리 로직` / Processing Logic — #/Event/Step (12 step slots) + Process Flow Chart heading
90	  5. `출력` / Output — Order/Field/Description/Length/Edit/Hidden (10 column slots)
91	  6. `권한` / Authorizations — Check/Object/Level/Implemented?/Notes (5 rows)
92	  7. `예외 처리` / Exceptions — Trigger/Mechanism/Message/Recovery (3 rows)
93	
94	  **Styles, borders, fonts, fills, column widths, row heights — all preserved** from `asset/template_base.xlsx`. Do NOT rebuild them in drivers; do NOT introduce parallel `rich-xlsx-template.mjs` style constants. The reference workbook is the single source of truth.
95	
96	  **Image anchors stay intact** — `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` anchors the two embedded images (Selection screen mockup at C4, ALV grid mockup at C19) on the `입력 및 화면` sheet. Swapping `sharedStrings.xml` does not touch drawings. To replace the embedded images for a specific program, see [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task, not part of the default clone path).
97	
98	**Step 4.5 — Image swap (opt-in only)**
99	
100	Trigger keywords (case-insensitive, EN+KO): `이미지도 교체` · `프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드` · `PNG mockup 교체` · `regenerate the embedded images` · `swap embedded images`. If none appear in the user's request, **skip** this step — the cloned xlsx keeps the template's program-agnostic Sheet 3 PNGs and the blank Sheet 4 drawing slot (correct default per [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement § Why opt-in only).
101	
102	When triggered:
103	1. Render Selection + ALV + Process Flow PNGs via `renderScreenImages({ selection, alv, processFlow, lang })` from `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` (or accept user-supplied PNGs). The `processFlow` slot is always rendered **horizontal** (xlsx readability mandate — full flow visible in one Excel viewport).
104	2. Call `swapImages({ xlsxPath, selectionPng, alvPng, processFlowPng })` from `scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs`, or run the CLI: `node scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs <out-xlsx> --selection <sel.png> --alv <alv.png> --process-flow <pf.png>`.
105	3. If `renderScreenImages` returns `null` for a slot (no headless browser), pass `null` through — that slot keeps its template state (Sheet 3 image preserved; Sheet 4 stays blank). Graceful degrade, never crashes.
106	
107	The process-flow slot injects `xl/media/image3.png` + a one-cell anchor into the previously-blank `xl/drawings/drawing4.xml` (Sheet 4 = 처리 로직) with `ext` computed from the PNG's IHDR (`px × 9525` EMU). `drawing3.xml` and its rels stay untouched. See [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement for the full CLI + programmatic example.
108

92	## Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task)
93	
94	`asset/template_base.xlsx` ships two reference PNGs on Sheet 3 (`입력 및 화면`) and reserves a blank container on Sheet 4 (`처리 로직`) for the per-program process flow:
95	
96	| Slot | xlsx path | Sheet | Anchor | Ext (template default) | Notes |
97	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
98	| `selection`  | `xl/media/image2.png` | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C4  | 8572500 × 2667000 EMU | Reference mockup ships in template |
99	| `alv`        | `xl/media/image1.png` | 3 (입력 및 화면) | C19 | 9715500 × 1752600 EMU | Reference mockup ships in template |
100	| `processFlow`| `xl/media/image3.png` | 4 (처리 로직)    | B19 | computed from PNG IHDR (px × 9525) | Slot is created on demand — `drawing4.xml` is blank in the template because every program has its own flow chart |
101	
102	The default `program-to-spec` clone path leaves the Sheet 3 images intact and leaves Sheet 4 without an image. The swap is **opt-in** — never run automatically. Trigger keywords: `이미지도 교체` · `프로세스 플로우 이미지 임베드` · `PNG mockup 교체` · `regenerate the embedded images` · `swap embedded images`.
103	
104	### CLI (zero-dep, after clone)
105	
106	```bash
107	node scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs <out-xlsx> --selection <sel.png> --alv <alv.png> --process-flow <pf.png>
108	```
109	
110	- `--selection`     → replaces `xl/media/image2.png` (Sheet 3, C4)
111	- `--alv`           → replaces `xl/media/image1.png` (Sheet 3, C19)
112	- `--process-flow`  → injects `xl/media/image3.png` + `drawing4.xml` oneCellAnchor + rels (Sheet 4, B19); ext = PNG width/height × 9525 EMU
113	- Any flag may be omitted; omitted slots keep their template state (image preserved for Sheet 3; Sheet 4 stays blank).
114	- Positional form (`<xlsx> <sel.png> <alv.png> <pf.png>`, use `-` to skip) also accepted.
115	
116	PNG signature is verified before any write; non-PNG input is rejected without touching the xlsx. `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` and its rels are explicitly preserved byte-for-byte. `xl/drawings/drawing4.xml` is mutated **only** when `--process-flow` is supplied.
117	
118	### Programmatic (in-memory, with screen-image-renderer)
119	
120	**Exact schema** (mismatched keys silently render an empty grid — verify before shipping):
121	
122	```js
123	import { renderScreenImages } from './scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs';
124	import { swapImages } from './scripts/spec/image-swap.mjs';
125	
126	const { selection, alv, processFlow } = await renderScreenImages({
127	  selection: {
128	    blockLabel: '조회 조건',                 // optional, default '조회 조건'
129	    fields: [                                // PARAMETERS / SELECT-OPTIONS rows
130	      { name: 'P_BUKRS', label: '회사코드',     required: true },
131	      { name: 'S_MATNR', label: '자재번호 범위', range: true, note: 'LOW~HIGH 입력' },
132	    ],
133	    optionFields: [/* {name, label, note} for checkbox-style options */],
134	  },
135	  alv: {
136	    // Column descriptor keys: name (REQUIRED, used as row-object key),
137	    //                        header (display text — falls back to name),
138	    //                        width (px, default 100),
139	    //                        align ('end' | 'left' | default centre),
140	    //                        hotspot (bool, blue underline), editable (bool, yellow cell)
141	    columns: [
142	      { name: 'MATNR', header: '자재',     width: 140 },
143	      { name: 'MAKTX', header: '자재설명', width: 320 },
144	      { name: 'LBKUM', header: '재고수량', width: 130, align: 'end' },
145	      { name: 'MEINS', header: '단위',     width: 80 },
146	    ],
147	    // sampleRows are OBJECTS keyed by column.name (NOT positional arrays).
148	    // Optional special keys: `_status` ('●'/'○'/'◉'), `_locked` (greys the row).
149	    sampleRows: [
150	      { MATNR: 'HALB-001234', MAKTX: '반제품 A (조립용)',   LBKUM: '120.00', MEINS: 'EA' },
151	      { MATNR: 'ROH-005678',  MAKTX: '원자재 B (강판)',     LBKUM: '450.50', MEINS: 'KG' },
152	      { MATNR: 'FERT-009999', MAKTX: '완제품 C (출하 대기)', LBKUM: '78.00',  MEINS: 'EA' },
153	    ],
154	    maxRows: 3,                              // hard-capped at 5 inside renderer
155	  },
156	  processFlow: ['시작', '입력 검증', '? 자재 마스터 존재?', 'BAPI 호출', 'ALV 출력', '! 종료'],
157	  lang: 'ko',
158	});
159	swapImages({
160	  xlsxPath: '.sc4sap/specs/ZMMR1001-20260524-ko.xlsx',
161	  selectionPng:   selection?.pngBuffer,    // null when no headless browser → slot skipped
162	  alvPng:         alv?.pngBuffer,
163	  processFlowPng: processFlow?.pngBuffer,  // always rendered HORIZONTAL by renderScreenImages
164	});
165	```
166	
167	Process Flow item prefixes: `?` = decision (diamond), `!` = terminal (pill), no prefix = process box. `renderScreenImages` forces **horizontal orientation** for the xlsx embed path so the entire flow fits one Excel viewport — Markdown callers that want a vertical chart should call `renderProcessFlowSVG()` directly with `orientation: 'vertical'` (the default).
168	
169	`renderScreenImages` returns `null` per slot when no headless browser is available (Chrome / Edge / Chromium not on PATH); pass that `null` through and the slot stays in its template state.
170	
171	### Why opt-in only
172	
173	Auto-replacement re-introduces the drift problem the clone workflow exists to prevent. The two Sheet-3 template PNGs are program-agnostic mockups that work for ≥95% of specs. The Sheet-4 process flow is left blank by design (every program differs). Run the swap ONLY when the user explicitly asks for program-specific imagery — never silently from the default `program-to-spec` path.

- `alv.columns[].align` — `'end'` (right-aligned, monospace for numerics) / `'left'` / default centre
- `alv.columns[].hotspot` — `true` renders the cell value as blue underlined text
- `alv.columns[].editable` — `true` renders a yellow input cell
- `alv.sampleRows[]` — **OBJECTS** keyed by `name` (NOT positional arrays). Special keys: `_status` (`'●'`/`'○'`/`'◉'`) for tri-state indicators, `_locked: true` to grey the row
- `processFlow[]` — string array. Prefix `?` = decision (diamond), `!` = terminal (pill), no prefix = process box. Always rendered **horizontal** in the xlsx embed path (Markdown callers wanting vertical should call `renderProcessFlowSVG()` directly with `orientation: 'vertical'`)

content.text:
Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\user\.claude\plugins\cache\sc4sap\sc4sap\0.6.14\skills\program-to-spec

# SC4SAP Program → Specification

Reads an existing ABAP program (Report / Module Pool / FM Group / Class / CDS / RAP) via MCP, runs structural + semantic + where-used analysis, then produces a Specification artifact in **Markdown** (`.md`) or **Excel** (`.xlsx`) format. Scope is **negotiated Socratically** — start wide, narrow on each turn, stop when the user's target granularity is confirmed.

<Purpose>
Turn legacy or unfamiliar ABAP objects into a reviewable Functional/Technical Spec for handover, documentation audit, AMS transition, refactoring preparation, or compliance artifacts. Unlike `analyze-code` (quality-focused), this skill is **documentation-focused**: it describes what the program DOES, not what's wrong with it.
</Purpose>

<Response_Prefix>Every response triggered by this skill MUST begin with `[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Response Prefix Convention.</Response_Prefix>

<Phase_Banner>Multi-phase skill. Before each `Agent(...)` dispatch, emit `▶ phase=<id> (<label>) · agent=<name> · model=<Opus 4.7|Sonnet 4.6|Haiku 4.5>` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Phase Banner Convention.</Phase_Banner>

<Team_Mode>**No teamMode integration.** program-to-spec targets a single object (one program / class / FM group / CDS / RAP BO) and performs read-only structural extraction — no cross-module synthesis, no authoring conflict, no incident triage. See [`../../docs/team-consultation-architecture.md`](../../docs/team-consultation-architecture.md) § 6 gating logic. Future extension: if a target's `GetWhereUsed` graph spans ≥ 2 modules AND user picks L4 depth, Type A (module consultants annotating cross-module concerns in Step 3) could be added — not in current scope.</Team_Mode>

<Use_When>
- User says "program to spec", "reverse engineer", "make a spec", "document this program", "functional specification", "technical specification", "generate a specification"
- Knowledge transfer / handover of legacy ABAP to another team
- Preparing a refactoring or rewrite (need to capture as-is behavior)
- Compliance / audit requires a written spec for custom code
- Building a WRICEF inventory with detailed per-object specs
</Use_When>

<Do_Not_Use_When>
- User wants a **code quality review** → `/sc4sap:analyze-code`
- User wants to **create a new** program from a spec → `/sc4sap:create-program`
- User wants to **fix** the program → direct MCP `Update*` calls or re-run `/sc4sap:create-program`
- Object does not exist yet
</Do_Not_Use_When>

<Session_Trust_Bootstrap>
**MANDATORY — runs as Step 0a before any MCP call or user interaction.**

Invoke `/sc4sap:trust-session` with `parent_skill=sc4sap:program-to-spec` to pre-grant MCP tool + file-op permissions (eliminates per-tool prompts during structural reads + screen rendering pipeline).

- If `.sc4sap/session-trust.log` already has a line within the last 24h, skip silently.
- Otherwise run it and surface the one-line confirmation.
- All `Agent` dispatches within this skill MUST pass `mode: "dontAsk"`.

Full spec: see [`../trust-session/SKILL.md`](../trust-session/SKILL.md).
</Session_Trust_Bootstrap>

<Socratic_Scope_Narrowing>
The interview is a **funnel**: every turn reduces the remaining decision space. Score remaining ambiguity 0–10 after each answer; stop when **≤3**.

**Default opener — bundled 4-question `AskUserQuestion`** (MANDATORY when the target object is already supplied in `ARGUMENTS`):
Issue ONE `AskUserQuestion` call with these four questions in this exact order — Audience / Format / Depth / Language — each a single-select with "(Recommended)" as the first option. This replaces Rounds 2+3+5 in one UI turn. Only fall back to per-round questioning when the object itself is missing or ambiguous (Round 1) or when the user picks L3/L4 (Round 4 scope trimming).

| # | Header | Question | Options (Recommended first) |
|---|--------|----------|-----------------------------|
| 1 | Audience | Who is the primary audience for the spec? | Both (Recommended) · Functional · Technical |
| 2 | Format | Which output format? | Markdown (Recommended) · Excel · Both |
| 3 | Depth | What depth of detail? | L2 Standard (Recommended) · L1 Quick Spec · L3 Deep Technical · L4 Audit-grade |
| 4 | Language | Output language? | Korean · English · Japanese (order follows user's current language — promote the matching one to first with "(Recommended)") |

**Round 1 — Target object (only if ARGUMENTS did not supply it)**
- "Which object? (program / FM group / class / CDS / RAP BO name)"
- Verify via `SearchObject`. If ambiguous, list candidates.

**Round 2 — Audience + format** *(covered by the default opener — do not ask separately)*
- Audience: **Functional** (business readers — SD/FI/MM users) vs **Technical** (developers) vs **Both**
- Format: **Markdown** (review-friendly, git-friendly) vs **Excel** (project-PMO-friendly, reviewable cell-by-cell)
- Default if user says "up to you" / "you choose" → Both + Markdown.

**Round 3 — Depth (pick one)** *(covered by the default opener)*
| Depth | Contains |
|-------|----------|
| **L1 — Quick Spec** | Purpose, inputs, outputs, **main logic steps** (numbered; for Module Pool includes PBO/PAI module flow) |
| **L2 — Standard Spec** (default) | L1 + inputs & screens, data model, authorizations, outputs, exceptions, **every subroutine / method signature** |
| **L3 — Deep Technical** | L2 + SQL inventory, BAdI / exit list, performance notes |
| **L4 — Audit-grade** | L3 + line-level cross-references, **where-used** (scope: main object + screens × `Z*` / `Y*` callers), risk register, transport history |

**Round 4 — Scope trimming (only if L3/L4)**
Ask ONE narrowing question per turn until ambiguity ≤3:
- "Include unit tests inventory?"
- "Include generated artifacts (Screens / GUI Status / Text Elements)?"
- "Cover all includes or just main?"

**Where-Used scope (L4 only — fixed default, no interactive prompt)**
- Target = main program / class / FM-group / CDS / RAP-BO object **+ each of its screens** (T1+Screen).
- Caller filter = customer namespace `Z*` / `Y*` only (S2). Standard SAP and add-on namespaces are excluded.
- The rendered `Where-Used` section MUST repeat this scope in its header so reviewers know what was (and wasn't) searched.

**Round 5 — Output location**
- Default: `.sc4sap/specs/{object_name}-{YYYYMMDD}-{lang}.{md|xlsx}`
- Language: ko / en / ja (infer from user's current language; confirm once).

**Stop condition**: every dimension above has a concrete answer OR user explicitly says "skip remaining, use defaults".
</Socratic_Scope_Narrowing>

<Workflow_Steps>
The 6-step workflow (Step 0 Socratic → Step 5 Review) lives in a companion file to keep this skill doc short.

**MUST read `workflow-steps.md`** (in this skill folder) and execute the steps defined there in order whenever this skill runs.
</Workflow_Steps>

<Spec_Templates>
The Markdown L2 skeleton and the Excel sheet-naming convention live in a companion file.

**MUST read `spec-templates.md`** (in this skill folder) when rendering the artifact in Step 4.
</Spec_Templates>

<Agent_Composition>
Per-step model allocation. Skill frontmatter pins the main thread to Sonnet; each `Agent(...)` carries its own model (frontmatter or explicit override).

- **Main orchestrator (Sonnet 4.6)** — Steps 0, 1, 1.5, 2, 5: Socratic interview orchestration, object classification routing, CBO context preload, Step 5 review loop. State tracking across depth / format / language dimensions needs Sonnet headroom.
- **Analysis (`sap-analyst` × 1, Opus 4.7, frontmatter)** — Step 3 primary dispatch: extracts business purpose, inputs, outputs, data sources (including CBO-annotated Z-references when `cbo-context.md` exists), main-logic narrative, authorization checks, error cases. One dispatch covers all narrative dimensions to keep context continuous.
- **Rendering (`sap-writer` × 1)** — Step 3 second dispatch (or Step 4 render invocation):
  - **L1 / L2 depth** → **Haiku 4.5** base (frontmatter). Pure templating from structured analyst output.
  - **L3 / L4 depth** → **Sonnet 4.6** override (`model: "sonnet"`) — longer narrative + deeper cross-reference + stronger consistency requirement.

**Universal applicability (v8.1):** the image pipeline runs for **every xlsx spec** regardless of language (ko / en / ja / de / …) and depth (**L1 / L2 / L3 / L4**). - **Yellow warning rows MUST sit at the BOTTOM** of the `Inputs & Screens` sheet — readers scan top→bottom.
