      set_cell_editable CHANGING cs_alv TYPE ty_alv,
      determine_icon CHANGING cs_alv TYPE ty_alv,
      set_mblnr_display CHANGING cs_alv TYPE ty_alv,
      aggregate_gr_qty IMPORTING it_ekpo TYPE tt_alv CHANGING ct_alv TYPE tt_alv,
      fetch_invoice CHANGING ct_alv TYPE tt_alv,
      get_next_version IMPORTING iv_ebeln TYPE ebeln iv_ebelp TYPE ebelp
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_version) TYPE numc5,
      insert_log IMPORTING iv_ebeln TYPE ebeln iv_ebelp TYPE ebelp iv_matnr TYPE matnr
        iv_menge TYPE bstmg iv_meins TYPE bstme iv_mblnr TYPE mblnr OPTIONAL
        iv_mjahr TYPE mjahr OPTIONAL iv_budat TYPE budat iv_msgty TYPE msgty
        iv_msgtx TYPE msgtx OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      on_toolbar FOR EVENT toolbar OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING e_object e_interactive,
      on_user_command FOR EVENT user_command OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING e_ucomm,
      on_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING er_data_changed,
      on_hotspot_click FOR EVENT hotspot_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
        IMPORTING e_row_id e_column_id es_row_no.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD fetch_data.
    SELECT ek~ebeln, ep~ebelp, ek~bukrs, ek~ekorg, ek~ekgrp,
           ek~bsart, ek~bedat, ek~lifnr, lf~name1,
           ep~matnr, ep~txz01, ep~werks, ep~lgort,
           ep~meins, ep~menge, ep~elikz
      FROM ekko AS ek
      INNER JOIN ekpo AS ep ON ep~ebeln = ek~ebeln
      LEFT OUTER JOIN lfa1 AS lf ON lf~lifnr = ek~lifnr
      WHERE ek~ekorg IN @s_ekorg AND ek~ekgrp IN @s_ekgrp
        AND ek~bsart IN @s_bsart AND ek~ebeln IN @s_ebeln
        AND ek~bedat IN @s_bedat AND ek~lifnr IN @s_lifnr
        AND ep~werks IN @s_werks AND ep~lgort IN @s_lgort
        AND ep~loekz = @space
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_alv.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '조회 결과가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    aggregate_gr_qty( EXPORTING it_ekpo = gt_alv CHANGING ct_alv = gt_alv ).
    fetch_invoice( CHANGING ct_alv = gt_alv ).
    LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_alv>).
      <fs_alv>-remain_qty = <fs_alv>-menge - <fs_alv>-gr_qty.
      IF p_undel = abap_true.
        IF <fs_alv>-elikz = abap_true OR <fs_alv>-remain_qty <= 0. DELETE gt_alv. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      <fs_alv>-inp_qty = <fs_alv>-remain_qty.
      determine_icon( CHANGING cs_alv = <fs_alv> ).
      set_cell_editable( CHANGING cs_alv = <fs_alv> ).
    ENDLOOP.
    IF gt_alv IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '조건에 맞는 데이터가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD aggregate_gr_qty.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN it_ekpo ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    CHECK lt_ebeln IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, bwart, SUM( menge ) AS menge FROM ekbe
      WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND bwart IN ('101','102')
      GROUP BY ebeln, ebelp, bwart INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_ekbe).
    LOOP AT ct_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>).
      LOOP AT lt_ekbe ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<eb>) WHERE ebeln = <fs>-ebeln AND ebelp = <fs>-ebelp.
        CASE <eb>-bwart.
          WHEN '101'. <fs>-gr_qty = <fs>-gr_qty + <eb>-menge.
          WHEN '102'. <fs>-gr_qty = <fs>-gr_qty - <eb>-menge.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, belnr, gjahr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ekbe
      WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND bwart = '101'
      GROUP BY ebeln, ebelp, belnr, gjahr INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_docs).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ds, ebeln TYPE ebeln, ebelp TYPE ebelp, doc_cnt TYPE i,
             mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr, END OF ty_ds.
    DATA lt_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ds. DATA ls_summary TYPE ty_ds.
    SORT lt_docs BY ebeln ebelp belnr DESCENDING.
    LOOP AT lt_docs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<doc>).
      READ TABLE lt_summary ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<sum>) WITH KEY ebeln = <doc>-ebeln ebelp = <doc>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <sum>-doc_cnt = <sum>-doc_cnt + 1.
      ELSE. CLEAR ls_summary. ls_summary-ebeln = <doc>-ebeln. ls_summary-ebelp = <doc>-ebelp.
        ls_summary-doc_cnt = 1. ls_summary-mblnr = <doc>-belnr. ls_summary-mjahr = <doc>-gjahr.
        APPEND ls_summary TO lt_summary.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT ct_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs2>).
      READ TABLE lt_summary ASSIGNING <sum> WITH KEY ebeln = <fs2>-ebeln ebelp = <fs2>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs2>-mblnr = <sum>-mblnr. <fs2>-mjahr = <sum>-mjahr.
        <fs2>-gr_count = <sum>-doc_cnt. set_mblnr_display( CHANGING cs_alv = <fs2> ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fetch_invoice.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN ct_alv ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln. CHECK lt_ebeln IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, belnr, gjahr FROM ekbe WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND vgabe = '2'
      ORDER BY ebeln, ebelp, cpudt DESCENDING, cputm DESCENDING INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_iv).
    LOOP AT ct_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>).
      READ TABLE lt_iv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<iv>) WITH KEY ebeln = <fs>-ebeln ebelp = <fs>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs>-belnr_iv = <iv>-belnr. <fs>-gjahr_iv = <iv>-gjahr. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_mblnr_display.
    IF cs_alv-gr_count > 1. cs_alv-mblnr_disp = icon_list.
    ELSEIF cs_alv-gr_count = 1. cs_alv-mblnr_disp = cs_alv-mblnr.
    ELSE. CLEAR cs_alv-mblnr_disp. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_version.
    DATA lv_max TYPE numc5.
    SELECT MAX( version ) FROM zmmt00004 WHERE ebeln = @iv_ebeln AND ebelp = @iv_ebelp INTO @lv_max.
    rv_version = lv_max + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD insert_log.
    DATA ls_log TYPE zmmt00004.
    ls_log-ebeln = iv_ebeln. ls_log-ebelp = iv_ebelp.
    ls_log-version = get_next_version( iv_ebeln = iv_ebeln iv_ebelp = iv_ebelp ).
    ls_log-matnr = iv_matnr. ls_log-menge = iv_menge. ls_log-meins = iv_meins.
    ls_log-mblnr = iv_mblnr. ls_log-mjahr = iv_mjahr. ls_log-budat = iv_budat.
    ls_log-msgty = iv_msgty. ls_log-msgtx = iv_msgtx.
    INSERT zmmt00004 FROM ls_log.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD show_gr_docs.
    DATA lt_docs TYPE tt_gr_doc.
    SELECT eb~belnr AS mblnr, eb~gjahr AS mjahr, eb~buzei AS zeile,
           eb~budat, eb~bwart, eb~menge, ep~meins
      FROM ekbe AS eb INNER JOIN ekpo AS ep ON ep~ebeln = eb~ebeln AND ep~ebelp = eb~ebelp
      WHERE eb~ebeln = @iv_ebeln AND eb~ebelp = @iv_ebelp AND eb~bwart IN ('101','102')
      ORDER BY eb~belnr DESCENDING, eb~buzei INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_docs.
    IF lt_docs IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 문서가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TRY.
        DATA lo_salv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv CHANGING t_table = lt_docs ).
        lo_salv->set_screen_popup( start_column = 10 end_column = 90 start_line = 5 end_line = 20 ).
        DATA(lo_cols) = lo_salv->get_columns( ). lo_cols->set_optimize( ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MBLNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재문서' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MJAHR' ) )->set_short_text( '연도' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'ZEILE' ) )->set_short_text( '항목' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BUDAT' ) )->set_short_text( '전기일' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BWART' ) )->set_short_text( '이동유형' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MENGE' ) )->set_short_text( '수량' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MEINS' ) )->set_short_text( '단위' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( |PO { iv_ebeln } / { iv_ebelp } 입고 문서 목록| ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ). lo_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD init_alv.
    IF go_docking IS NOT BOUND.
      go_docking = NEW cl_gui_docking_container( side = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_top ratio = 90 ).
      go_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container( parent = go_docking rows = 2 columns = 1 ).
      go_splitter->set_row_height( id = 1 height = 12 ).
      go_top_cont = go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
      go_alv_cont = go_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).
      go_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = go_alv_cont ).
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_toolbar FOR go_grid.
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_user_command FOR go_grid.
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_data_changed FOR go_grid.
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_hotspot_click FOR go_grid.
      go_grid->set_ready_for_input( i_ready_for_input = 1 ).
      DATA lt_exclude TYPE ui_functions.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste_new_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo TO lt_exclude.
      DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat. lt_fcat = build_fieldcat( ).
      go_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING is_layout = build_layout( ) i_save = 'A' it_toolbar_excluding = lt_exclude
        CHANGING it_outtab = gt_alv it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat ).
      go_grid->register_edit_event( i_event_id = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_evt_modified ).
      build_top_of_page( ).
    ELSE. refresh_alv( ). ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_top_of_page.
    DATA lv_text TYPE sdydo_text_element.
    DATA: lv_ekorg TYPE string, lv_ekgrp TYPE string, lv_lifnr TYPE string.
    LOOP AT s_ekorg ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<eo>). IF lv_ekorg IS NOT INITIAL. lv_ekorg = lv_ekorg && ', '. ENDIF. lv_ekorg = lv_ekorg && <eo>-low. ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT s_ekgrp ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<eg>). IF lv_ekgrp IS NOT INITIAL. lv_ekgrp = lv_ekgrp && ', '. ENDIF. lv_ekgrp = lv_ekgrp && <eg>-low. ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT s_lifnr ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lf>). IF lv_lifnr IS NOT INITIAL. lv_lifnr = lv_lifnr && ', '. ENDIF. lv_lifnr = lv_lifnr && <lf>-low. ENDLOOP.
    CREATE OBJECT go_doc. go_doc->initialize_document( ).
    lv_text = |구매조직 : { lv_ekorg }|. go_doc->add_text( text = lv_text ). go_doc->new_line( ).
    lv_text = |구매그룹 : { lv_ekgrp }|. go_doc->add_text( text = lv_text ). go_doc->new_line( ).
    lv_text = |공급업체 : { lv_lifnr }|. go_doc->add_text( text = lv_text ).
    go_doc->display_document( parent = go_top_cont ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_layout.
    rs_layout-zebra = abap_true. rs_layout-sel_mode = 'A'. rs_layout-stylefname = 'CELLTAB'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_fieldcat.
    DATA ls TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DEFINE _add_fcat.
      CLEAR ls. ls-fieldname = &1. ls-coltext = &2. ls-outputlen = &3. ls-edit = &4. ls-no_out = &5. APPEND ls TO rt_fcat.
    END-OF-DEFINITION.
    _add_fcat: 'MESSAGE' '메시지' 30 '' ''.       _add_fcat: 'ICON' '상태' 7 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'EBELN' 'PO번호' 10 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'EBELP' '품목' 5 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'BUKRS' '회사코드' 4 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'EKORG' '구매조직' 4 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'EKGRP' '구매그룹' 3 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'BSART' '구매유형' 4 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'BEDAT' 'PO일자' 10 '' ''.          _add_fcat: 'LIFNR' '공급업체' 10 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'NAME1' '공급업체명' 30 '' ''.      _add_fcat: 'MATNR' '자재번호' 18 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'TXZ01' '자재명' 30 '' ''.          _add_fcat: 'WERKS' '플랜트' 4 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'LGORT' '저장위치' 4 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'MEINS' '단위' 3 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'MENGE' '발주수량' 13 '' ''.        _add_fcat: 'GR_QTY' '기입고수량' 13 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'REMAIN_QTY' '잔량' 13 '' ''.       _add_fcat: 'INP_QTY' '입고수량' 13 'X' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'ELIKZ' '납품완료' 3 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'MBLNR_DISP' '자재문서' 12 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'BELNR_IV' '인보이스' 10 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'MBLNR' '자재문서' 10 '' 'X'.       _add_fcat: 'MJAHR' '문서연도' 4 '' 'X'.
    _add_fcat: 'GR_COUNT' '문서건수' 3 '' 'X'.     _add_fcat: 'GJAHR_IV' 'IV연도' 4 '' 'X'.
    _add_fcat: 'MSG_TYPE' '유형' 1 '' 'X'.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ic>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'ICON'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <ic>-icon = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<el>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'ELIKZ'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <el>-checkbox = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<md>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'MBLNR_DISP'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <md>-icon = abap_true. <md>-hotspot = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<po>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'EBELN'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <po>-hotspot = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<iv>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'BELNR_IV'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <iv>-hotspot = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lf>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'LIFNR'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <lf>-convexit = 'ALPHA'. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<mt>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'MATNR'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <mt>-convexit = 'MATN1'. ENDIF.
    LOOP AT rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fc>)
      WHERE fieldname = 'MENGE' OR fieldname = 'GR_QTY' OR fieldname = 'REMAIN_QTY' OR fieldname = 'INP_QTY'.
      <fc>-ref_table = 'EKPO'. <fc>-ref_field = 'MENGE'. <fc>-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_cell_editable.
    DATA ls_styl TYPE lvc_s_styl.
    IF cs_alv-elikz = abap_true OR cs_alv-remain_qty <= 0.
      ls_styl-fieldname = 'INP_QTY'. ls_styl-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.
      INSERT ls_styl INTO TABLE cs_alv-celltab.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD determine_icon.
    IF cs_alv-elikz = abap_true OR cs_alv-remain_qty <= 0. cs_alv-icon = gc_icon_green.
    ELSEIF cs_alv-gr_qty > 0. cs_alv-icon = gc_icon_yellow.
    ELSE. cs_alv-icon = gc_icon_red. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_posting_dates.
    DATA lt_fields TYPE TABLE OF sval. DATA ls_field TYPE sval. DATA lv_rc TYPE c.
    CLEAR: ev_budat, ev_bldat, ev_cancel.
    ls_field-tabname = 'MKPF'. ls_field-fieldname = 'BUDAT'. ls_field-value = sy-datum. ls_field-fieldtext = 'Posting Date'. APPEND ls_field TO lt_fields.
    CLEAR ls_field. ls_field-tabname = 'MKPF'. ls_field-fieldname = 'BLDAT'. ls_field-value = sy-datum. ls_field-fieldtext = 'Document Date'. APPEND ls_field TO lt_fields.
    CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_GET_VALUES' EXPORTING popup_title = '전기일 / 증빙일 입력' IMPORTING returncode = lv_rc TABLES fields = lt_fields EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_rc = 'A'. ev_cancel = abap_true. RETURN. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE lt_fields INTO ls_field INDEX 1. ev_budat = ls_field-value.
    READ TABLE lt_fields INTO ls_field INDEX 2. ev_bldat = ls_field-value.
    IF ev_budat IS INITIAL. ev_budat = sy-datum. ENDIF. IF ev_bldat IS INITIAL. ev_bldat = sy-datum. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD post_gr.
    go_grid->check_changed_data( ).
    DATA lt_rows TYPE lvc_t_row. go_grid->get_selected_rows( IMPORTING et_index_rows = lt_rows ).
    IF lt_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 처리할 항목을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_selected TYPE tt_alv.
    LOOP AT lt_rows ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<sel>) INDEX <row>-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc = 0 AND <sel>-remain_qty > 0. APPEND <sel> TO lt_selected.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_selected IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 가능한 항목이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<chk>).
      IF <chk>-inp_qty <= 0 OR <chk>-inp_qty > <chk>-remain_qty.
        MESSAGE s001(00) WITH <chk>-ebeln <chk>-ebelp '수량 오류' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA: lv_budat TYPE budat, lv_bldat TYPE bldat, lv_cancel TYPE abap_bool.
    get_posting_dates( IMPORTING ev_budat = lv_budat ev_bldat = lv_bldat ev_cancel = lv_cancel ).
    IF lv_cancel = abap_true. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고가 취소되었습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_po_list TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ebeln WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    lt_po_list = VALUE #( FOR ls2 IN lt_selected ( ls2-ebeln ) ).
    DATA: ls_header TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_01, ls_code TYPE bapi2017_gm_code,
          lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapi2017_gm_item_create,
          lt_return TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2,
          lv_matdoc TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_ret-mat_doc, lv_matyear TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_ret-doc_year,
          lv_has_error TYPE abap_bool, lv_err_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
    LOOP AT lt_po_list ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<po>).
      CLEAR: ls_header, ls_code, lt_items, lt_return, lv_matdoc, lv_matyear, lv_has_error, lv_err_msg.
      ls_header-pstng_date = lv_budat. ls_header-doc_date = lv_bldat. ls_code-gm_code = gc_gm_code.
      LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
        APPEND VALUE bapi2017_gm_item_create( po_number = <sel>-ebeln po_item = <sel>-ebelp
          mvt_ind = 'B' move_type = gc_mvt_type entry_qnt = <sel>-inp_qty
          entry_uom = <sel>-meins stge_loc = <sel>-lgort ) TO lt_items.
      ENDLOOP.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE'
        EXPORTING goodsmvt_header = ls_header goodsmvt_code = ls_code
        IMPORTING materialdocument = lv_matdoc matdocumentyear = lv_matyear
        TABLES goodsmvt_item = lt_items return = lt_return.
      lv_has_error = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_return ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ret>) WHERE type CA 'EA'. lv_has_error = abap_true. EXIT. ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_has_error = abap_false AND lv_matdoc IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          insert_log( iv_ebeln = <sel>-ebeln iv_ebelp = <sel>-ebelp iv_matnr = <sel>-matnr
            iv_menge = <sel>-inp_qty iv_meins = <sel>-meins iv_mblnr = lv_matdoc
            iv_mjahr = lv_matyear iv_budat = lv_budat iv_msgty = 'S' ).
        ENDLOOP.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT' EXPORTING wait = abap_true.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<upd>) WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
          <upd>-mblnr = lv_matdoc. <upd>-mjahr = lv_matyear.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'S'. <upd>-message = |자재문서 { lv_matdoc } 생성 완료|.
          <upd>-gr_qty = <upd>-gr_qty + <upd>-inp_qty. <upd>-remain_qty = <upd>-menge - <upd>-gr_qty.
          <upd>-gr_count = <upd>-gr_count + 1.
          set_mblnr_display( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ). determine_icon( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ). set_cell_editable( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'. CLEAR lv_err_msg.
        READ TABLE lt_return ASSIGNING <ret> WITH KEY type = 'E'. IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_err_msg = <ret>-message. ENDIF.
        LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          insert_log( iv_ebeln = <sel>-ebeln iv_ebelp = <sel>-ebelp iv_matnr = <sel>-matnr
            iv_menge = <sel>-inp_qty iv_meins = <sel>-meins iv_budat = lv_budat
            iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgtx = CONV msgtx( lv_err_msg ) ).
        ENDLOOP. COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp.
          CHECK sy-subrc = 0. <upd>-msg_type = 'E'. <upd>-message = lv_err_msg.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    refresh_alv( ). MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD post_invoice.
    go_grid->check_changed_data( ).
    DATA lt_rows TYPE lvc_t_row. go_grid->get_selected_rows( IMPORTING et_index_rows = lt_rows ).
    IF lt_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '인보이스 발행할 항목을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_selected TYPE tt_alv.
    LOOP AT lt_rows ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<sel>) INDEX <row>-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc = 0 AND <sel>-inp_qty > 0. APPEND <sel> TO lt_selected.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_selected IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '발행 가능한 항목이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA: lv_budat TYPE budat, lv_bldat TYPE bldat, lv_cancel TYPE abap_bool.
    get_posting_dates( IMPORTING ev_budat = lv_budat ev_bldat = lv_bldat ev_cancel = lv_cancel ).
    IF lv_cancel = abap_true. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN lt_selected ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    SELECT ek~ebeln, ep~ebelp, ep~netpr, ep~peinh, ep~mwskz, ek~waers
      FROM ekko AS ek INNER JOIN ekpo AS ep ON ep~ebeln = ek~ebeln
      WHERE ek~ebeln IN @lt_ebeln INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_price).
    DATA lt_po_list TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ebeln WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    lt_po_list = VALUE #( FOR ls2 IN lt_selected ( ls2-ebeln ) ).
    DATA: ls_header TYPE bapi_incinv_create_header,
          lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapi_incinv_create_item,
          lt_return TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2,
          lv_inv_doc TYPE bapi_incinv_fld-inv_doc_no, lv_fisc_yr TYPE bapi_incinv_fld-fisc_year,
          lv_item_no TYPE n LENGTH 10, lv_gross TYPE wrbtr, lv_item_amt TYPE wrbtr,
          lv_peinh TYPE peinh, lv_waers TYPE waers, lv_bukrs TYPE bukrs,
          lv_tax_code TYPE mwskz, lv_has_error TYPE abap_bool, lv_err_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
    LOOP AT lt_po_list ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<po>).
      CLEAR: ls_header, lt_items, lt_return, lv_inv_doc, lv_fisc_yr, lv_has_error, lv_err_msg, lv_gross.
      lv_item_no = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
        lv_bukrs = <sel>-bukrs.
        READ TABLE lt_price ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<pr>) WITH KEY ebeln = <sel>-ebeln ebelp = <sel>-ebelp.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
        lv_waers = <pr>-waers. lv_item_no = lv_item_no + 1.
        lv_peinh = COND #( WHEN <pr>-peinh > 0 THEN <pr>-peinh ELSE 1 ).
        lv_item_amt = <pr>-netpr * <sel>-inp_qty / lv_peinh. lv_gross = lv_gross + lv_item_amt.
        lv_tax_code = COND #( WHEN <pr>-mwskz IS NOT INITIAL THEN <pr>-mwskz ELSE 'I0' ).
        APPEND VALUE bapi_incinv_create_item( invoice_doc_item = lv_item_no
          po_number = <sel>-ebeln po_item = <sel>-ebelp tax_code = lv_tax_code
          item_amount = lv_item_amt quantity = <sel>-inp_qty po_unit = <sel>-meins ) TO lt_items.
      ENDLOOP.
      ls_header-invoice_ind = 'X'. ls_header-doc_type = 'RE'.
      ls_header-doc_date = lv_bldat. ls_header-pstng_date = lv_budat.
      ls_header-ref_doc_no = <po>.
      ls_header-comp_code = lv_bukrs. ls_header-currency = lv_waers.
      ls_header-gross_amount = lv_gross. ls_header-calc_tax_ind = 'X'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE'
        EXPORTING headerdata = ls_header
        IMPORTING invoicedocnumber = lv_inv_doc fiscalyear = lv_fisc_yr
        TABLES itemdata = lt_items return = lt_return.
      lv_has_error = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_return ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ret>) WHERE type CA 'EA'. lv_has_error = abap_true. EXIT. ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_has_error = abap_false AND lv_inv_doc IS NOT INITIAL.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT' EXPORTING wait = abap_true.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<upd>) WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
          <upd>-belnr_iv = lv_inv_doc. <upd>-gjahr_iv = lv_fisc_yr.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'S'. <upd>-message = |인보이스 { lv_inv_doc } 생성 완료|.
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'. CLEAR lv_err_msg.
        READ TABLE lt_return ASSIGNING <ret> WITH KEY type = 'E'. IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_err_msg = <ret>-message. ENDIF.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'E'. <upd>-message = lv_err_msg.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    refresh_alv( ). MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '인보이스 처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cancel_gr.
    go_grid->check_changed_data( ).
    DATA lt_rows TYPE lvc_t_row. go_grid->get_selected_rows( IMPORTING et_index_rows = lt_rows ).
    IF lt_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '취소할 항목을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_po_key, ebeln TYPE ebeln, ebelp TYPE ebelp, END OF ty_po_key.
    DATA lt_po_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_po_key. DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    LOOP AT lt_rows ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<alv>) INDEX <row>-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc = 0 AND <alv>-gr_count > 0.
      APPEND VALUE ty_po_key( ebeln = <alv>-ebeln ebelp = <alv>-ebelp ) TO lt_po_items.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_po_items IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 문서가 있는 항목이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN lt_po_items ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw, ebeln TYPE ebeln, ebelp TYPE ebelp,
             mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr, budat TYPE budat, menge TYPE menge_d, END OF ty_raw.
    DATA lt_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, belnr AS mblnr, gjahr AS mjahr, budat, menge
      FROM ekbe WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND bwart = '101'
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_raw.
    LOOP AT lt_raw ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<raw>).
      READ TABLE lt_po_items TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <raw>-ebeln ebelp = <raw>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. DELETE lt_raw. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_raw IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 문서가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, meins FROM ekpo FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_raw
      WHERE ebeln = @lt_raw-ebeln AND ebelp = @lt_raw-ebelp INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_unit).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cd, mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr,
             budat TYPE budat, menge TYPE menge_d, meins TYPE meins, bktxt TYPE bktxt, END OF ty_cd.
    DATA lt_docs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cd. DATA ls_doc TYPE ty_cd.
    SORT lt_raw BY mblnr mjahr.
    LOOP AT lt_raw ASSIGNING <raw>.
      READ TABLE lt_docs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<d>) WITH KEY mblnr = <raw>-mblnr mjahr = <raw>-mjahr.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <d>-menge = <d>-menge + <raw>-menge.
      ELSE. CLEAR ls_doc. ls_doc-mblnr = <raw>-mblnr. ls_doc-mjahr = <raw>-mjahr.
        ls_doc-budat = <raw>-budat. ls_doc-menge = <raw>-menge.
        READ TABLE lt_unit ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<u>) WITH KEY ebeln = <raw>-ebeln ebelp = <raw>-ebelp.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. ls_doc-meins = <u>-meins. ENDIF. APPEND ls_doc TO lt_docs.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_docs IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT mblnr, mjahr, bktxt FROM mkpf FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_docs
        WHERE mblnr = @lt_docs-mblnr AND mjahr = @lt_docs-mjahr INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mkpf).
      LOOP AT lt_docs ASSIGNING <d>.
        READ TABLE lt_mkpf ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<mk>) WITH KEY mblnr = <d>-mblnr mjahr = <d>-mjahr.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <d>-bktxt = <mk>-bktxt. ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    SORT lt_docs BY mblnr DESCENDING.
    DATA lt_sel_rows TYPE salv_t_row.
    TRY.
        DATA lo_salv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv CHANGING t_table = lt_docs ).
        lo_salv->set_screen_popup( start_column = 10 end_column = 110 start_line = 5 end_line = 20 ).
        DATA(lo_sel) = lo_salv->get_selections( ). lo_sel->set_selection_mode( if_salv_c_selection_mode=>multiple ).
        DATA(lo_cols) = lo_salv->get_columns( ). lo_cols->set_optimize( ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MBLNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재문서' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MJAHR' ) )->set_short_text( '문서연도' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BUDAT' ) )->set_short_text( '전기일' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MENGE' ) )->set_short_text( '수량' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MEINS' ) )->set_short_text( '단위' ).
        DATA(lo_bk) = CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BKTXT' ) ).
        lo_bk->set_short_text( '참조텍스트' ). lo_bk->set_medium_text( '헤더참조텍스트' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( '취소할 입고 문서를 선택 후 체크' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ).
        lo_salv->display( ). lt_sel_rows = lo_sel->get_selected_rows( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found. RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
    IF lt_sel_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '선택된 문서가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dk, mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr, END OF ty_dk.
    DATA lt_cancel TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dk.
    LOOP AT lt_sel_rows INTO DATA(lv_idx).
      READ TABLE lt_docs INTO ls_doc INDEX lv_idx. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
      APPEND VALUE ty_dk( mblnr = ls_doc-mblnr mjahr = ls_doc-mjahr ) TO lt_cancel.
    ENDLOOP.
    " 최종 확인
    DATA lv_answer TYPE c. DATA lv_doc_cnt TYPE string. lv_doc_cnt = lines( lt_cancel ).
    CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
      EXPORTING titlebar = '입고 취소 확인'
        text_question = |선택한 { lv_doc_cnt }건의 자재문서를 취소하시겠습니까?|
        text_button_1 = '예' text_button_2 = '아니오' default_button = '2' display_cancel_button = ' '
      IMPORTING answer = lv_answer.
    IF lv_answer <> '1'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA: lv_budat TYPE budat, lv_bldat TYPE bldat, lv_cancel_flag TYPE abap_bool.
    get_posting_dates( IMPORTING ev_budat = lv_budat ev_bldat = lv_bldat ev_cancel = lv_cancel_flag ).
    IF lv_cancel_flag = abap_true. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA: lt_return TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2, lv_has_error TYPE abap_bool, lv_err_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
    LOOP AT lt_cancel INTO DATA(ls_cancel).
      CLEAR: lt_return, lv_has_error, lv_err_msg.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_GOODSMVT_CANCEL'
        EXPORTING materialdocument = ls_cancel-mblnr matdocumentyear = ls_cancel-mjahr goodsmvt_pstng_date = lv_budat
        TABLES return = lt_return.
      lv_has_error = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_return ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ret>) WHERE type CA 'EA'. lv_has_error = abap_true. EXIT. ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_has_error = abap_false.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT' EXPORTING wait = abap_true.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<upd>). CHECK <upd>-mblnr = ls_cancel-mblnr AND <upd>-mjahr = ls_cancel-mjahr.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'S'. <upd>-message = |자재문서 { ls_cancel-mblnr } 취소 완료|.
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'. CLEAR lv_err_msg.
        READ TABLE lt_return ASSIGNING <ret> WITH KEY type = 'E'. IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_err_msg = <ret>-message. ENDIF.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd>. CHECK <upd>-mblnr = ls_cancel-mblnr AND <upd>-mjahr = ls_cancel-mjahr.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'E'. <upd>-message = lv_err_msg.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd>. CLEAR: <upd>-gr_qty, <upd>-mblnr, <upd>-mjahr, <upd>-gr_count, <upd>-mblnr_disp. ENDLOOP.
    aggregate_gr_qty( EXPORTING it_ekpo = gt_alv CHANGING ct_alv = gt_alv ).
    LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd>.
      <upd>-remain_qty = <upd>-menge - <upd>-gr_qty. <upd>-inp_qty = <upd>-remain_qty. CLEAR <upd>-celltab.
      determine_icon( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ). set_cell_editable( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ).
    ENDLOOP.
    refresh_alv( ). MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 취소 처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD show_log.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN gt_alv ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    IF lt_ebeln IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '조회된 데이터가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zmmt00004.
    SELECT * FROM zmmt00004 WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln ORDER BY ebeln, ebelp, version DESCENDING INTO TABLE @lt_log.
    IF lt_log IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '표시할 로그가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TRY.
        DATA lo_salv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv CHANGING t_table = lt_log ).
        lo_salv->set_screen_popup( start_column = 5 end_column = 130 start_line = 3 end_line = 25 ).
        DATA(lo_cols) = lo_salv->get_columns( ). lo_cols->set_optimize( ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MANDT' ) )->set_visible( abap_false ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'EBELN' ) )->set_short_text( 'PO번호' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'EBELP' ) )->set_short_text( '품목' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'VERSION' ) )->set_short_text( '버전' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MATNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재번호' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MENGE' ) )->set_short_text( '수량' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MEINS' ) )->set_short_text( '단위' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MBLNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재문서' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MJAHR' ) )->set_short_text( '문서연도' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BUDAT' ) )->set_short_text( '전기일' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MSGTY' ) )->set_short_text( '유형' ).
        DATA(lo_tx) = CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MSGTX' ) ).
        lo_tx->set_short_text( '메시지' ). lo_tx->set_medium_text( '메시지텍스트' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( '입고 처리 로그 (ZMMT00004)' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ). lo_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD refresh_alv.
    CHECK go_grid IS BOUND. DATA ls_stable TYPE lvc_s_stbl. ls_stable-row = abap_true. ls_stable-col = abap_true.
    go_grid->refresh_table_display( is_stable = ls_stable ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_alv.
    IF go_grid IS BOUND. go_grid->free( ). FREE go_grid. ENDIF.
    IF go_splitter IS BOUND. go_splitter->free( ). FREE go_splitter. ENDIF.
    IF go_docking IS BOUND. go_docking->free( ). FREE go_docking. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_toolbar.
    DELETE e_object->mt_toolbar WHERE function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste_new_row
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( butn_type = 3 ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'POST_GR' icon = icon_execute_object quickinfo = '입고 처리' text = '입고 실행' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'CANCEL_GR' icon = icon_cancel quickinfo = '입고 취소' text = '입고 취소' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( butn_type = 3 ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'POST_IV' icon = icon_create quickinfo = '인보이스 발행' text = '인보이스 발행' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( butn_type = 3 ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'SHOW_LOG' icon = icon_protocol quickinfo = '로그 보기' text = '로그' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_user_command.
    CASE e_ucomm.
      WHEN 'POST_GR'. lcl_app=>post_gr( ). WHEN 'CANCEL_GR'. lcl_app=>cancel_gr( ).
      WHEN 'POST_IV'. lcl_app=>post_invoice( ). WHEN 'SHOW_LOG'. lcl_app=>show_log( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_hotspot_click.
    READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) INDEX es_row_no-row_id. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
    CASE e_column_id-fieldname.
      WHEN 'EBELN'. CHECK <fs>-ebeln IS NOT INITIAL.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'BES' FIELD <fs>-ebeln. CALL TRANSACTION 'ME23N' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
      WHEN 'MBLNR_DISP'. CHECK <fs>-gr_count > 0.
        IF <fs>-gr_count = 1.
          CALL FUNCTION 'MIGO_DIALOG' EXPORTING i_action = 'A04' i_refdoc = 'R02' i_notree = 'X'
            i_no_auth_check = ' ' i_mblnr = <fs>-mblnr i_mjahr = <fs>-mjahr.
        ELSE. lcl_app=>show_gr_docs( iv_ebeln = <fs>-ebeln iv_ebelp = <fs>-ebelp ). ENDIF.
      WHEN 'BELNR_IV'. CHECK <fs>-belnr_iv IS NOT INITIAL.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'RBN' FIELD <fs>-belnr_iv. SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD <fs>-gjahr_iv.
        CALL TRANSACTION 'MIR4' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_data_changed.
    LOOP AT er_data_changed->mt_good_cells ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<cell>) WHERE fieldname = 'INP_QTY'.
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>) INDEX <cell>-row_id. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_new_qty) = CONV bstmg( <cell>-value ).
      IF lv_new_qty < 0 OR lv_new_qty > <row>-remain_qty.
        er_data_changed->add_protocol_entry( i_msgid = '00' i_msgno = '001' i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgv1 = '수량은 0 ~ 잔량 범위여야 합니다' i_fieldname = 'INP_QTY' i_row_id = <cell>-row_id ).
        er_data_changed->modify_cell( i_row_id = <cell>-row_id i_fieldname = 'INP_QTY' i_value = <row>-remain_qty ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include ZMMRTEST004C - Local Class Definition & Implementation
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: gv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      fetch_data, init_alv, post_gr, post_invoice, cancel_gr, show_log,
      get_posting_dates EXPORTING ev_budat TYPE budat ev_bldat TYPE bldat ev_cancel TYPE abap_bool,
      show_gr_docs IMPORTING iv_ebeln TYPE ebeln iv_ebelp TYPE ebelp,
      refresh_alv, free_alv.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      build_fieldcat RETURNING VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
      build_layout RETURNING VALUE(rs_layout) TYPE lvc_s_layo,
      build_top_of_page,
      set_cell_editable CHANGING cs_alv TYPE ty_alv,
      determine_icon CHANGING cs_alv TYPE ty_alv,
      set_mblnr_display CHANGING cs_alv TYPE ty_alv,
      aggregate_gr_qty IMPORTING it_ekpo TYPE tt_alv CHANGING ct_alv TYPE tt_alv,
      fetch_invoice CHANGING ct_alv TYPE tt_alv,
      get_next_version IMPORTING iv_ebeln TYPE ebeln iv_ebelp TYPE ebelp
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_version) TYPE numc5,
      insert_log IMPORTING iv_ebeln TYPE ebeln iv_ebelp TYPE ebelp iv_matnr TYPE matnr
        iv_menge TYPE bstmg iv_meins TYPE bstme iv_mblnr TYPE mblnr OPTIONAL
        iv_mjahr TYPE mjahr OPTIONAL iv_budat TYPE budat iv_msgty TYPE msgty
        iv_msgtx TYPE msgtx OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      on_toolbar FOR EVENT toolbar OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING e_object e_interactive,
      on_user_command FOR EVENT user_command OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING e_ucomm,
      on_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING er_data_changed,
      on_hotspot_click FOR EVENT hotspot_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
        IMPORTING e_row_id e_column_id es_row_no.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD fetch_data.
    SELECT ek~ebeln, ep~ebelp, ek~bukrs, ek~ekorg, ek~ekgrp,
           ek~bsart, ek~bedat, ek~lifnr, lf~name1,
           ep~matnr, ep~txz01, ep~werks, ep~lgort,
           ep~meins, ep~menge, ep~elikz
      FROM ekko AS ek
      INNER JOIN ekpo AS ep ON ep~ebeln = ek~ebeln
      LEFT OUTER JOIN lfa1 AS lf ON lf~lifnr = ek~lifnr
      WHERE ek~ekorg IN @s_ekorg AND ek~ekgrp IN @s_ekgrp
        AND ek~bsart IN @s_bsart AND ek~ebeln IN @s_ebeln
        AND ek~bedat IN @s_bedat AND ek~lifnr IN @s_lifnr
        AND ep~werks IN @s_werks AND ep~lgort IN @s_lgort
        AND ep~loekz = @space
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_alv.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '조회 결과가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    aggregate_gr_qty( EXPORTING it_ekpo = gt_alv CHANGING ct_alv = gt_alv ).
    fetch_invoice( CHANGING ct_alv = gt_alv ).
    LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_alv>).
      <fs_alv>-remain_qty = <fs_alv>-menge - <fs_alv>-gr_qty.
      IF p_undel = abap_true.
        IF <fs_alv>-elikz = abap_true OR <fs_alv>-remain_qty <= 0. DELETE gt_alv. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      <fs_alv>-inp_qty = <fs_alv>-remain_qty.
      determine_icon( CHANGING cs_alv = <fs_alv> ).
      set_cell_editable( CHANGING cs_alv = <fs_alv> ).
    ENDLOOP.
    IF gt_alv IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '조건에 맞는 데이터가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD aggregate_gr_qty.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN it_ekpo ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    CHECK lt_ebeln IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, bwart, SUM( menge ) AS menge FROM ekbe
      WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND bwart IN ('101','102')
      GROUP BY ebeln, ebelp, bwart INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_ekbe).
    LOOP AT ct_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>).
      LOOP AT lt_ekbe ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<eb>) WHERE ebeln = <fs>-ebeln AND ebelp = <fs>-ebelp.
        CASE <eb>-bwart.
          WHEN '101'. <fs>-gr_qty = <fs>-gr_qty + <eb>-menge.
          WHEN '102'. <fs>-gr_qty = <fs>-gr_qty - <eb>-menge.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, belnr, gjahr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ekbe
      WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND bwart = '101'
      GROUP BY ebeln, ebelp, belnr, gjahr INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_docs).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ds, ebeln TYPE ebeln, ebelp TYPE ebelp, doc_cnt TYPE i,
             mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr, END OF ty_ds.
    DATA lt_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ds. DATA ls_summary TYPE ty_ds.
    SORT lt_docs BY ebeln ebelp belnr DESCENDING.
    LOOP AT lt_docs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<doc>).
      READ TABLE lt_summary ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<sum>) WITH KEY ebeln = <doc>-ebeln ebelp = <doc>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <sum>-doc_cnt = <sum>-doc_cnt + 1.
      ELSE. CLEAR ls_summary. ls_summary-ebeln = <doc>-ebeln. ls_summary-ebelp = <doc>-ebelp.
        ls_summary-doc_cnt = 1. ls_summary-mblnr = <doc>-belnr. ls_summary-mjahr = <doc>-gjahr.
        APPEND ls_summary TO lt_summary.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT ct_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs2>).
      READ TABLE lt_summary ASSIGNING <sum> WITH KEY ebeln = <fs2>-ebeln ebelp = <fs2>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs2>-mblnr = <sum>-mblnr. <fs2>-mjahr = <sum>-mjahr.
        <fs2>-gr_count = <sum>-doc_cnt. set_mblnr_display( CHANGING cs_alv = <fs2> ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fetch_invoice.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN ct_alv ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln. CHECK lt_ebeln IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, belnr, gjahr FROM ekbe WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND vgabe = '2'
      ORDER BY ebeln, ebelp, cpudt DESCENDING, cputm DESCENDING INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_iv).
    LOOP AT ct_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>).
      READ TABLE lt_iv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<iv>) WITH KEY ebeln = <fs>-ebeln ebelp = <fs>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs>-belnr_iv = <iv>-belnr. <fs>-gjahr_iv = <iv>-gjahr. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_mblnr_display.
    IF cs_alv-gr_count > 1. cs_alv-mblnr_disp = icon_list.
    ELSEIF cs_alv-gr_count = 1. cs_alv-mblnr_disp = cs_alv-mblnr.
    ELSE. CLEAR cs_alv-mblnr_disp. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_version.
    DATA lv_max TYPE numc5.
    SELECT MAX( version ) FROM zmmt00004 WHERE ebeln = @iv_ebeln AND ebelp = @iv_ebelp INTO @lv_max.
    rv_version = lv_max + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD insert_log.
    DATA ls_log TYPE zmmt00004.
    ls_log-ebeln = iv_ebeln. ls_log-ebelp = iv_ebelp.
    ls_log-version = get_next_version( iv_ebeln = iv_ebeln iv_ebelp = iv_ebelp ).
    ls_log-matnr = iv_matnr. ls_log-menge = iv_menge. ls_log-meins = iv_meins.
    ls_log-mblnr = iv_mblnr. ls_log-mjahr = iv_mjahr. ls_log-budat = iv_budat.
    ls_log-msgty = iv_msgty. ls_log-msgtx = iv_msgtx.
    INSERT zmmt00004 FROM ls_log.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD show_gr_docs.
    DATA lt_docs TYPE tt_gr_doc.
    SELECT eb~belnr AS mblnr, eb~gjahr AS mjahr, eb~buzei AS zeile,
           eb~budat, eb~bwart, eb~menge, ep~meins
      FROM ekbe AS eb INNER JOIN ekpo AS ep ON ep~ebeln = eb~ebeln AND ep~ebelp = eb~ebelp
      WHERE eb~ebeln = @iv_ebeln AND eb~ebelp = @iv_ebelp AND eb~bwart IN ('101','102')
      ORDER BY eb~belnr DESCENDING, eb~buzei INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_docs.
    IF lt_docs IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 문서가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TRY.
        DATA lo_salv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv CHANGING t_table = lt_docs ).
        lo_salv->set_screen_popup( start_column = 10 end_column = 90 start_line = 5 end_line = 20 ).
        DATA(lo_cols) = lo_salv->get_columns( ). lo_cols->set_optimize( ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MBLNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재문서' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MJAHR' ) )->set_short_text( '연도' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'ZEILE' ) )->set_short_text( '항목' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BUDAT' ) )->set_short_text( '전기일' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BWART' ) )->set_short_text( '이동유형' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MENGE' ) )->set_short_text( '수량' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MEINS' ) )->set_short_text( '단위' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( |PO { iv_ebeln } / { iv_ebelp } 입고 문서 목록| ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ). lo_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD init_alv.
    IF go_docking IS NOT BOUND.
      go_docking = NEW cl_gui_docking_container( side = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_top ratio = 90 ).
      go_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container( parent = go_docking rows = 2 columns = 1 ).
      go_splitter->set_row_height( id = 1 height = 12 ).
      go_top_cont = go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
      go_alv_cont = go_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).
      go_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = go_alv_cont ).
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_toolbar FOR go_grid.
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_user_command FOR go_grid.
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_data_changed FOR go_grid.
      SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>on_hotspot_click FOR go_grid.
      go_grid->set_ready_for_input( i_ready_for_input = 1 ).
      DATA lt_exclude TYPE ui_functions.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste_new_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO lt_exclude.
      APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo TO lt_exclude.
      DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat. lt_fcat = build_fieldcat( ).
      go_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING is_layout = build_layout( ) i_save = 'A' it_toolbar_excluding = lt_exclude
        CHANGING it_outtab = gt_alv it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat ).
      go_grid->register_edit_event( i_event_id = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_evt_modified ).
      build_top_of_page( ).
    ELSE. refresh_alv( ). ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_top_of_page.
    DATA lv_text TYPE sdydo_text_element.
    DATA: lv_ekorg TYPE string, lv_ekgrp TYPE string, lv_lifnr TYPE string.
    LOOP AT s_ekorg ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<eo>). IF lv_ekorg IS NOT INITIAL. lv_ekorg = lv_ekorg && ', '. ENDIF. lv_ekorg = lv_ekorg && <eo>-low. ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT s_ekgrp ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<eg>). IF lv_ekgrp IS NOT INITIAL. lv_ekgrp = lv_ekgrp && ', '. ENDIF. lv_ekgrp = lv_ekgrp && <eg>-low. ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT s_lifnr ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lf>). IF lv_lifnr IS NOT INITIAL. lv_lifnr = lv_lifnr && ', '. ENDIF. lv_lifnr = lv_lifnr && <lf>-low. ENDLOOP.
    CREATE OBJECT go_doc. go_doc->initialize_document( ).
    lv_text = |구매조직 : { lv_ekorg }|. go_doc->add_text( text = lv_text ). go_doc->new_line( ).
    lv_text = |구매그룹 : { lv_ekgrp }|. go_doc->add_text( text = lv_text ). go_doc->new_line( ).
    lv_text = |공급업체 : { lv_lifnr }|. go_doc->add_text( text = lv_text ).
    go_doc->display_document( parent = go_top_cont ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_layout.
    rs_layout-zebra = abap_true. rs_layout-sel_mode = 'A'. rs_layout-stylefname = 'CELLTAB'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_fieldcat.
    DATA ls TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DEFINE _add_fcat.
      CLEAR ls. ls-fieldname = &1. ls-coltext = &2. ls-outputlen = &3. ls-edit = &4. ls-no_out = &5. APPEND ls TO rt_fcat.
    END-OF-DEFINITION.
    _add_fcat: 'MESSAGE' '메시지' 30 '' ''.       _add_fcat: 'ICON' '상태' 7 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'EBELN' 'PO번호' 10 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'EBELP' '품목' 5 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'BUKRS' '회사코드' 4 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'EKORG' '구매조직' 4 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'EKGRP' '구매그룹' 3 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'BSART' '구매유형' 4 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'BEDAT' 'PO일자' 10 '' ''.          _add_fcat: 'LIFNR' '공급업체' 10 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'NAME1' '공급업체명' 30 '' ''.      _add_fcat: 'MATNR' '자재번호' 18 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'TXZ01' '자재명' 30 '' ''.          _add_fcat: 'WERKS' '플랜트' 4 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'LGORT' '저장위치' 4 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'MEINS' '단위' 3 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'MENGE' '발주수량' 13 '' ''.        _add_fcat: 'GR_QTY' '기입고수량' 13 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'REMAIN_QTY' '잔량' 13 '' ''.       _add_fcat: 'INP_QTY' '입고수량' 13 'X' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'ELIKZ' '납품완료' 3 '' ''.         _add_fcat: 'MBLNR_DISP' '자재문서' 12 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'BELNR_IV' '인보이스' 10 '' ''.
    _add_fcat: 'MBLNR' '자재문서' 10 '' 'X'.       _add_fcat: 'MJAHR' '문서연도' 4 '' 'X'.
    _add_fcat: 'GR_COUNT' '문서건수' 3 '' 'X'.     _add_fcat: 'GJAHR_IV' 'IV연도' 4 '' 'X'.
    _add_fcat: 'MSG_TYPE' '유형' 1 '' 'X'.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ic>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'ICON'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <ic>-icon = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<el>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'ELIKZ'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <el>-checkbox = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<md>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'MBLNR_DISP'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <md>-icon = abap_true. <md>-hotspot = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<po>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'EBELN'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <po>-hotspot = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<iv>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'BELNR_IV'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <iv>-hotspot = abap_true. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lf>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'LIFNR'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <lf>-convexit = 'ALPHA'. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<mt>) WITH KEY fieldname = 'MATNR'. IF sy-subrc = 0. <mt>-convexit = 'MATN1'. ENDIF.
    LOOP AT rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fc>)
      WHERE fieldname = 'MENGE' OR fieldname = 'GR_QTY' OR fieldname = 'REMAIN_QTY' OR fieldname = 'INP_QTY'.
      <fc>-ref_table = 'EKPO'. <fc>-ref_field = 'MENGE'. <fc>-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_cell_editable.
    DATA ls_styl TYPE lvc_s_styl.
    IF cs_alv-elikz = abap_true OR cs_alv-remain_qty <= 0.
      ls_styl-fieldname = 'INP_QTY'. ls_styl-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.
      INSERT ls_styl INTO TABLE cs_alv-celltab.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD determine_icon.
    IF cs_alv-elikz = abap_true OR cs_alv-remain_qty <= 0. cs_alv-icon = gc_icon_green.
    ELSEIF cs_alv-gr_qty > 0. cs_alv-icon = gc_icon_yellow.
    ELSE. cs_alv-icon = gc_icon_red. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_posting_dates.
    DATA lt_fields TYPE TABLE OF sval. DATA ls_field TYPE sval. DATA lv_rc TYPE c.
    CLEAR: ev_budat, ev_bldat, ev_cancel.
    ls_field-tabname = 'MKPF'. ls_field-fieldname = 'BUDAT'. ls_field-value = sy-datum. ls_field-fieldtext = 'Posting Date'. APPEND ls_field TO lt_fields.
    CLEAR ls_field. ls_field-tabname = 'MKPF'. ls_field-fieldname = 'BLDAT'. ls_field-value = sy-datum. ls_field-fieldtext = 'Document Date'. APPEND ls_field TO lt_fields.
    CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_GET_VALUES' EXPORTING popup_title = '전기일 / 증빙일 입력' IMPORTING returncode = lv_rc TABLES fields = lt_fields EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_rc = 'A'. ev_cancel = abap_true. RETURN. ENDIF.
    READ TABLE lt_fields INTO ls_field INDEX 1. ev_budat = ls_field-value.
    READ TABLE lt_fields INTO ls_field INDEX 2. ev_bldat = ls_field-value.
    IF ev_budat IS INITIAL. ev_budat = sy-datum. ENDIF. IF ev_bldat IS INITIAL. ev_bldat = sy-datum. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD post_gr.
    go_grid->check_changed_data( ).
    DATA lt_rows TYPE lvc_t_row. go_grid->get_selected_rows( IMPORTING et_index_rows = lt_rows ).
    IF lt_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 처리할 항목을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_selected TYPE tt_alv.
    LOOP AT lt_rows ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<sel>) INDEX <row>-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc = 0 AND <sel>-remain_qty > 0. APPEND <sel> TO lt_selected.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_selected IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 가능한 항목이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<chk>).
      IF <chk>-inp_qty <= 0 OR <chk>-inp_qty > <chk>-remain_qty.
        MESSAGE s001(00) WITH <chk>-ebeln <chk>-ebelp '수량 오류' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA: lv_budat TYPE budat, lv_bldat TYPE bldat, lv_cancel TYPE abap_bool.
    get_posting_dates( IMPORTING ev_budat = lv_budat ev_bldat = lv_bldat ev_cancel = lv_cancel ).
    IF lv_cancel = abap_true. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고가 취소되었습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_po_list TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ebeln WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    lt_po_list = VALUE #( FOR ls2 IN lt_selected ( ls2-ebeln ) ).
    DATA: ls_header TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_01, ls_code TYPE bapi2017_gm_code,
          lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapi2017_gm_item_create,
          lt_return TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2,
          lv_matdoc TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_ret-mat_doc, lv_matyear TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_ret-doc_year,
          lv_has_error TYPE abap_bool, lv_err_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
    LOOP AT lt_po_list ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<po>).
      CLEAR: ls_header, ls_code, lt_items, lt_return, lv_matdoc, lv_matyear, lv_has_error, lv_err_msg.
      ls_header-pstng_date = lv_budat. ls_header-doc_date = lv_bldat. ls_code-gm_code = gc_gm_code.
      LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
        APPEND VALUE bapi2017_gm_item_create( po_number = <sel>-ebeln po_item = <sel>-ebelp
          mvt_ind = 'B' move_type = gc_mvt_type entry_qnt = <sel>-inp_qty
          entry_uom = <sel>-meins stge_loc = <sel>-lgort ) TO lt_items.
      ENDLOOP.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE'
        EXPORTING goodsmvt_header = ls_header goodsmvt_code = ls_code
        IMPORTING materialdocument = lv_matdoc matdocumentyear = lv_matyear
        TABLES goodsmvt_item = lt_items return = lt_return.
      lv_has_error = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_return ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ret>) WHERE type CA 'EA'. lv_has_error = abap_true. EXIT. ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_has_error = abap_false AND lv_matdoc IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          insert_log( iv_ebeln = <sel>-ebeln iv_ebelp = <sel>-ebelp iv_matnr = <sel>-matnr
            iv_menge = <sel>-inp_qty iv_meins = <sel>-meins iv_mblnr = lv_matdoc
            iv_mjahr = lv_matyear iv_budat = lv_budat iv_msgty = 'S' ).
        ENDLOOP.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT' EXPORTING wait = abap_true.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<upd>) WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
          <upd>-mblnr = lv_matdoc. <upd>-mjahr = lv_matyear.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'S'. <upd>-message = |자재문서 { lv_matdoc } 생성 완료|.
          <upd>-gr_qty = <upd>-gr_qty + <upd>-inp_qty. <upd>-remain_qty = <upd>-menge - <upd>-gr_qty.
          <upd>-gr_count = <upd>-gr_count + 1.
          set_mblnr_display( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ). determine_icon( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ). set_cell_editable( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'. CLEAR lv_err_msg.
        READ TABLE lt_return ASSIGNING <ret> WITH KEY type = 'E'. IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_err_msg = <ret>-message. ENDIF.
        LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          insert_log( iv_ebeln = <sel>-ebeln iv_ebelp = <sel>-ebelp iv_matnr = <sel>-matnr
            iv_menge = <sel>-inp_qty iv_meins = <sel>-meins iv_budat = lv_budat
            iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgtx = CONV msgtx( lv_err_msg ) ).
        ENDLOOP. COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp.
          CHECK sy-subrc = 0. <upd>-msg_type = 'E'. <upd>-message = lv_err_msg.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    refresh_alv( ). MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD post_invoice.
    go_grid->check_changed_data( ).
    DATA lt_rows TYPE lvc_t_row. go_grid->get_selected_rows( IMPORTING et_index_rows = lt_rows ).
    IF lt_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '인보이스 발행할 항목을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_selected TYPE tt_alv.
    LOOP AT lt_rows ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<sel>) INDEX <row>-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc = 0 AND <sel>-inp_qty > 0. APPEND <sel> TO lt_selected.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_selected IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '발행 가능한 항목이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA: lv_budat TYPE budat, lv_bldat TYPE bldat, lv_cancel TYPE abap_bool.
    get_posting_dates( IMPORTING ev_budat = lv_budat ev_bldat = lv_bldat ev_cancel = lv_cancel ).
    IF lv_cancel = abap_true. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN lt_selected ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    SELECT ek~ebeln, ep~ebelp, ep~netpr, ep~peinh, ep~mwskz, ek~waers
      FROM ekko AS ek INNER JOIN ekpo AS ep ON ep~ebeln = ek~ebeln
      WHERE ek~ebeln IN @lt_ebeln INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_price).
    DATA lt_po_list TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ebeln WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    lt_po_list = VALUE #( FOR ls2 IN lt_selected ( ls2-ebeln ) ).
    DATA: ls_header TYPE bapi_incinv_create_header,
          lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapi_incinv_create_item,
          lt_return TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2,
          lv_inv_doc TYPE bapi_incinv_fld-inv_doc_no, lv_fisc_yr TYPE bapi_incinv_fld-fisc_year,
          lv_item_no TYPE n LENGTH 10, lv_gross TYPE wrbtr, lv_item_amt TYPE wrbtr,
          lv_peinh TYPE peinh, lv_waers TYPE waers, lv_bukrs TYPE bukrs,
          lv_tax_code TYPE mwskz, lv_has_error TYPE abap_bool, lv_err_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
    LOOP AT lt_po_list ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<po>).
      CLEAR: ls_header, lt_items, lt_return, lv_inv_doc, lv_fisc_yr, lv_has_error, lv_err_msg, lv_gross.
      lv_item_no = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_selected ASSIGNING <sel> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
        lv_bukrs = <sel>-bukrs.
        READ TABLE lt_price ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<pr>) WITH KEY ebeln = <sel>-ebeln ebelp = <sel>-ebelp.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
        lv_waers = <pr>-waers. lv_item_no = lv_item_no + 1.
        lv_peinh = COND #( WHEN <pr>-peinh > 0 THEN <pr>-peinh ELSE 1 ).
        lv_item_amt = <pr>-netpr * <sel>-inp_qty / lv_peinh. lv_gross = lv_gross + lv_item_amt.
        lv_tax_code = COND #( WHEN <pr>-mwskz IS NOT INITIAL THEN <pr>-mwskz ELSE 'I0' ).
        APPEND VALUE bapi_incinv_create_item( invoice_doc_item = lv_item_no
          po_number = <sel>-ebeln po_item = <sel>-ebelp tax_code = lv_tax_code
          item_amount = lv_item_amt quantity = <sel>-inp_qty po_unit = <sel>-meins ) TO lt_items.
      ENDLOOP.
      ls_header-invoice_ind = 'X'. ls_header-doc_type = 'RE'.
      ls_header-doc_date = lv_bldat. ls_header-pstng_date = lv_budat.
      ls_header-ref_doc_no = <po>.
      ls_header-comp_code = lv_bukrs. ls_header-currency = lv_waers.
      ls_header-gross_amount = lv_gross. ls_header-calc_tax_ind = 'X'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE'
        EXPORTING headerdata = ls_header
        IMPORTING invoicedocnumber = lv_inv_doc fiscalyear = lv_fisc_yr
        TABLES itemdata = lt_items return = lt_return.
      lv_has_error = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_return ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ret>) WHERE type CA 'EA'. lv_has_error = abap_true. EXIT. ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_has_error = abap_false AND lv_inv_doc IS NOT INITIAL.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT' EXPORTING wait = abap_true.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<upd>) WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
          <upd>-belnr_iv = lv_inv_doc. <upd>-gjahr_iv = lv_fisc_yr.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'S'. <upd>-message = |인보이스 { lv_inv_doc } 생성 완료|.
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'. CLEAR lv_err_msg.
        READ TABLE lt_return ASSIGNING <ret> WITH KEY type = 'E'. IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_err_msg = <ret>-message. ENDIF.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd> WHERE ebeln = <po>.
          READ TABLE lt_selected TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <upd>-ebeln ebelp = <upd>-ebelp. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'E'. <upd>-message = lv_err_msg.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    refresh_alv( ). MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '인보이스 처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cancel_gr.
    go_grid->check_changed_data( ).
    DATA lt_rows TYPE lvc_t_row. go_grid->get_selected_rows( IMPORTING et_index_rows = lt_rows ).
    IF lt_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '취소할 항목을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_po_key, ebeln TYPE ebeln, ebelp TYPE ebelp, END OF ty_po_key.
    DATA lt_po_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_po_key. DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    LOOP AT lt_rows ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<alv>) INDEX <row>-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc = 0 AND <alv>-gr_count > 0.
      APPEND VALUE ty_po_key( ebeln = <alv>-ebeln ebelp = <alv>-ebelp ) TO lt_po_items.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_po_items IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 문서가 있는 항목이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN lt_po_items ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw, ebeln TYPE ebeln, ebelp TYPE ebelp,
             mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr, budat TYPE budat, menge TYPE menge_d, END OF ty_raw.
    DATA lt_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, belnr AS mblnr, gjahr AS mjahr, budat, menge
      FROM ekbe WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln AND bwart = '101'
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_raw.
    LOOP AT lt_raw ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<raw>).
      READ TABLE lt_po_items TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ebeln = <raw>-ebeln ebelp = <raw>-ebelp.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. DELETE lt_raw. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_raw IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 문서가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    SELECT ebeln, ebelp, meins FROM ekpo FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_raw
      WHERE ebeln = @lt_raw-ebeln AND ebelp = @lt_raw-ebelp INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_unit).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cd, mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr,
             budat TYPE budat, menge TYPE menge_d, meins TYPE meins, bktxt TYPE bktxt, END OF ty_cd.
    DATA lt_docs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cd. DATA ls_doc TYPE ty_cd.
    SORT lt_raw BY mblnr mjahr.
    LOOP AT lt_raw ASSIGNING <raw>.
      READ TABLE lt_docs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<d>) WITH KEY mblnr = <raw>-mblnr mjahr = <raw>-mjahr.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <d>-menge = <d>-menge + <raw>-menge.
      ELSE. CLEAR ls_doc. ls_doc-mblnr = <raw>-mblnr. ls_doc-mjahr = <raw>-mjahr.
        ls_doc-budat = <raw>-budat. ls_doc-menge = <raw>-menge.
        READ TABLE lt_unit ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<u>) WITH KEY ebeln = <raw>-ebeln ebelp = <raw>-ebelp.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. ls_doc-meins = <u>-meins. ENDIF. APPEND ls_doc TO lt_docs.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_docs IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT mblnr, mjahr, bktxt FROM mkpf FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_docs
        WHERE mblnr = @lt_docs-mblnr AND mjahr = @lt_docs-mjahr INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mkpf).
      LOOP AT lt_docs ASSIGNING <d>.
        READ TABLE lt_mkpf ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<mk>) WITH KEY mblnr = <d>-mblnr mjahr = <d>-mjahr.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <d>-bktxt = <mk>-bktxt. ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    SORT lt_docs BY mblnr DESCENDING.
    DATA lt_sel_rows TYPE salv_t_row.
    TRY.
        DATA lo_salv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv CHANGING t_table = lt_docs ).
        lo_salv->set_screen_popup( start_column = 10 end_column = 110 start_line = 5 end_line = 20 ).
        DATA(lo_sel) = lo_salv->get_selections( ). lo_sel->set_selection_mode( if_salv_c_selection_mode=>multiple ).
        DATA(lo_cols) = lo_salv->get_columns( ). lo_cols->set_optimize( ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MBLNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재문서' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MJAHR' ) )->set_short_text( '문서연도' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BUDAT' ) )->set_short_text( '전기일' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MENGE' ) )->set_short_text( '수량' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MEINS' ) )->set_short_text( '단위' ).
        DATA(lo_bk) = CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BKTXT' ) ).
        lo_bk->set_short_text( '참조텍스트' ). lo_bk->set_medium_text( '헤더참조텍스트' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( '취소할 입고 문서를 선택 후 체크' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ).
        lo_salv->display( ). lt_sel_rows = lo_sel->get_selected_rows( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found. RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
    IF lt_sel_rows IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '선택된 문서가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dk, mblnr TYPE mblnr, mjahr TYPE mjahr, END OF ty_dk.
    DATA lt_cancel TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dk.
    LOOP AT lt_sel_rows INTO DATA(lv_idx).
      READ TABLE lt_docs INTO ls_doc INDEX lv_idx. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
      APPEND VALUE ty_dk( mblnr = ls_doc-mblnr mjahr = ls_doc-mjahr ) TO lt_cancel.
    ENDLOOP.
    " 최종 확인
    DATA lv_answer TYPE c. DATA lv_doc_cnt TYPE string. lv_doc_cnt = lines( lt_cancel ).
    CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
      EXPORTING titlebar = '입고 취소 확인'
        text_question = |선택한 { lv_doc_cnt }건의 자재문서를 취소하시겠습니까?|
        text_button_1 = '예' text_button_2 = '아니오' default_button = '2' display_cancel_button = ' '
      IMPORTING answer = lv_answer.
    IF lv_answer <> '1'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA: lv_budat TYPE budat, lv_bldat TYPE bldat, lv_cancel_flag TYPE abap_bool.
    get_posting_dates( IMPORTING ev_budat = lv_budat ev_bldat = lv_bldat ev_cancel = lv_cancel_flag ).
    IF lv_cancel_flag = abap_true. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA: lt_return TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2, lv_has_error TYPE abap_bool, lv_err_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
    LOOP AT lt_cancel INTO DATA(ls_cancel).
      CLEAR: lt_return, lv_has_error, lv_err_msg.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_GOODSMVT_CANCEL'
        EXPORTING materialdocument = ls_cancel-mblnr matdocumentyear = ls_cancel-mjahr goodsmvt_pstng_date = lv_budat
        TABLES return = lt_return.
      lv_has_error = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_return ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ret>) WHERE type CA 'EA'. lv_has_error = abap_true. EXIT. ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_has_error = abap_false.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT' EXPORTING wait = abap_true.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<upd>). CHECK <upd>-mblnr = ls_cancel-mblnr AND <upd>-mjahr = ls_cancel-mjahr.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'S'. <upd>-message = |자재문서 { ls_cancel-mblnr } 취소 완료|.
        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'. CLEAR lv_err_msg.
        READ TABLE lt_return ASSIGNING <ret> WITH KEY type = 'E'. IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_err_msg = <ret>-message. ENDIF.
        LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd>. CHECK <upd>-mblnr = ls_cancel-mblnr AND <upd>-mjahr = ls_cancel-mjahr.
          <upd>-msg_type = 'E'. <upd>-message = lv_err_msg.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd>. CLEAR: <upd>-gr_qty, <upd>-mblnr, <upd>-mjahr, <upd>-gr_count, <upd>-mblnr_disp. ENDLOOP.
    aggregate_gr_qty( EXPORTING it_ekpo = gt_alv CHANGING ct_alv = gt_alv ).
    LOOP AT gt_alv ASSIGNING <upd>.
      <upd>-remain_qty = <upd>-menge - <upd>-gr_qty. <upd>-inp_qty = <upd>-remain_qty. CLEAR <upd>-celltab.
      determine_icon( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ). set_cell_editable( CHANGING cs_alv = <upd> ).
    ENDLOOP.
    refresh_alv( ). MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '입고 취소 처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD show_log.
    DATA lt_ebeln TYPE RANGE OF ebeln.
    lt_ebeln = VALUE #( FOR ls IN gt_alv ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls-ebeln ) ).
    SORT lt_ebeln. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ebeln.
    IF lt_ebeln IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '조회된 데이터가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA lt_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zmmt00004.
    SELECT * FROM zmmt00004 WHERE ebeln IN @lt_ebeln ORDER BY ebeln, ebelp, version DESCENDING INTO TABLE @lt_log.
    IF lt_log IS INITIAL. MESSAGE s001(00) WITH '표시할 로그가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    TRY.
        DATA lo_salv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv CHANGING t_table = lt_log ).
        lo_salv->set_screen_popup( start_column = 5 end_column = 130 start_line = 3 end_line = 25 ).
        DATA(lo_cols) = lo_salv->get_columns( ). lo_cols->set_optimize( ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MANDT' ) )->set_visible( abap_false ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'EBELN' ) )->set_short_text( 'PO번호' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'EBELP' ) )->set_short_text( '품목' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'VERSION' ) )->set_short_text( '버전' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MATNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재번호' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MENGE' ) )->set_short_text( '수량' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MEINS' ) )->set_short_text( '단위' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MBLNR' ) )->set_short_text( '자재문서' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MJAHR' ) )->set_short_text( '문서연도' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'BUDAT' ) )->set_short_text( '전기일' ).
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MSGTY' ) )->set_short_text( '유형' ).
        DATA(lo_tx) = CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'MSGTX' ) ).
        lo_tx->set_short_text( '메시지' ). lo_tx->set_medium_text( '메시지텍스트' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( '입고 처리 로그 (ZMMT00004)' ).
        lo_salv->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ). lo_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD refresh_alv.
    CHECK go_grid IS BOUND. DATA ls_stable TYPE lvc_s_stbl. ls_stable-row = abap_true. ls_stable-col = abap_true.
    go_grid->refresh_table_display( is_stable = ls_stable ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_alv.
    IF go_grid IS BOUND. go_grid->free( ). FREE go_grid. ENDIF.
    IF go_splitter IS BOUND. go_splitter->free( ). FREE go_splitter. ENDIF.
    IF go_docking IS BOUND. go_docking->free( ). FREE go_docking. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_toolbar.
    DELETE e_object->mt_toolbar WHERE function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_paste_new_row
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row
      OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row OR function = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( butn_type = 3 ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'POST_GR' icon = icon_execute_object quickinfo = '입고 처리' text = '입고 실행' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'CANCEL_GR' icon = icon_cancel quickinfo = '입고 취소' text = '입고 취소' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( butn_type = 3 ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'POST_IV' icon = icon_create quickinfo = '인보이스 발행' text = '인보이스 발행' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( butn_type = 3 ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
    APPEND VALUE stb_button( function = 'SHOW_LOG' icon = icon_protocol quickinfo = '로그 보기' text = '로그' ) TO e_object->mt_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_user_command.
    CASE e_ucomm.
      WHEN 'POST_GR'. lcl_app=>post_gr( ). WHEN 'CANCEL_GR'. lcl_app=>cancel_gr( ).
      WHEN 'POST_IV'. lcl_app=>post_invoice( ). WHEN 'SHOW_LOG'. lcl_app=>show_log( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_hotspot_click.
    READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) INDEX es_row_no-row_id. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
    CASE e_column_id-fieldname.
      WHEN 'EBELN'. CHECK <fs>-ebeln IS NOT INITIAL.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'BES' FIELD <fs>-ebeln. CALL TRANSACTION 'ME23N' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
      WHEN 'MBLNR_DISP'. CHECK <fs>-gr_count > 0.
        IF <fs>-gr_count = 1.
          CALL FUNCTION 'MIGO_DIALOG' EXPORTING i_action = 'A04' i_refdoc = 'R02' i_notree = 'X'
            i_no_auth_check = ' ' i_mblnr = <fs>-mblnr i_mjahr = <fs>-mjahr.
        ELSE. lcl_app=>show_gr_docs( iv_ebeln = <fs>-ebeln iv_ebelp = <fs>-ebelp ). ENDIF.
      WHEN 'BELNR_IV'. CHECK <fs>-belnr_iv IS NOT INITIAL.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'RBN' FIELD <fs>-belnr_iv. SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD <fs>-gjahr_iv.
        CALL TRANSACTION 'MIR4' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_data_changed.
    LOOP AT er_data_changed->mt_good_cells ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<cell>) WHERE fieldname = 'INP_QTY'.
      READ TABLE gt_alv ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>) INDEX <cell>-row_id. CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_new_qty) = CONV bstmg( <cell>-value ).
      IF lv_new_qty < 0 OR lv_new_qty > <row>-remain_qty.
        er_data_changed->add_protocol_entry( i_msgid = '00' i_msgno = '001' i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgv1 = '수량은 0 ~ 잔량 범위여야 합니다' i_fieldname = 'INP_QTY' i_row_id = <cell>-row_id ).
        er_data_changed->modify_cell( i_row_id = <cell>-row_id i_fieldname = 'INP_QTY' i_value = <row>-remain_qty ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

content.subject: scripts/spec/build-spec.mjs 단일 entry point 신규
content.description: cloneTemplate + renderScreenImages + swapImages를 한 번에 묶는 entry. sap-writer는 tr.json + image-spec.json 두 개만 만들면 되고, 이 helper가 자동으로 PNG 렌더 후 swap까지. CLI: node build-spec.mjs <tr.json> <image-spec.json> <out.xlsx>. headless browser 없으면 graceful degrade.

content.subject: workflow-steps.md Step 4 통합 (opt-in → auto-execute)
content.description: Step 4.5 (opt-in image swap) 제거. Step 4 Excel 분기에 image-spec.json + build-spec.mjs 자동 흐름 박아넣기. 트리거 키워드 의존성 제거. drift 우려 해소 설명 (drift는 geometry 회귀 문제고 image swap은 ext+media만 갱신).
content.activeForm: Integrating image swap into default workflow

content.subject: spec-templates.md image-spec.json 스키마 명시
